title: Critical--localized reentry under periodic spacer control
summary: Tracking a fixed fraction of a quasiperiodic spectrum tests whether repeated critical--localized alternation extends over a nonzero spectral weight. We find such alternation in a matched-dimer chain by varying only the spacer on-site energies and following a fixed interval of integrated-density-of-states (IDS) labels. An exact Bloch-determinant identity links the physical transfer discriminant to the bands of a periodic reference operator. For the golden cell frequency, we prove that, on a common full-measure set of phases and for every finite value of the spacer control, the physical spectrum in the open reference bands is critical, with purely singular-continuous spectrum and zero Lyapunov exponent, while the spectrum strictly outside the bands is pure point, with exponentially decaying eigenfunctions. Validated IDS bounds certify repeated critical--localized alternation of the same fixed spectral fraction at successive spacer controls. Spacer shifts move the physical levels and reference-band edges at different rates, allowing us to reshape finite-chain return windows and place their endpoints at prescribed controls. An affine recalibration relocates the control family exactly.

AI.tldr: 在匹配二聚体链中仅调节间隔位点能并跟踪固定IDS谱分数，可实现非零谱权重上的重复临界—局域交替；Bloch行列式恒等式与IDS界给出严格证明及可控窗口设计。
AI.motivation: 检验准周期谱中固定比例谱权重是否呈现重复的临界—局域交替，并实现对有限链回返窗口的可控重整形与定位。
AI.method: 采用匹配二聚体链，变化spacer在位能并跟踪固定积分态密度（IDS）标签区间；建立精确Bloch行列式恒等式，将物理转移判别式联系到周期参考算符的能带；针对黄金胞频率证明谱性质，并用IDS界认证交替；利用物理能级与参考带边随spacer控制的不同移动速率重整形回返窗口，再通过仿射重标定精确移动控制族。
AI.result: 对全测度相位集及每个有限spacer控制，参考开带内的物理谱为临界谱，具有纯奇异连续谱和零Lyapunov指数；严格位于带外的谱为纯点谱，本征函数指数衰减。IDS界证明同一固定谱分数在连续spacer控制下重复出现临界—局域交替；并可把有限链回返窗口端点置于指定控制，精确重定位控制族。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明并实现了匹配二聚体链中固定谱分数的重复临界—局域交替，提供了准周期谱性质与有限链窗口的可控设计方案。

title: Wegner model in high dimension: singular continuous spectrum from U(1) symmetry breaking and AAT self-consistency
summary: We analyze the energy-spectral decomposition of the Wegner one-orbital model in high lattice dimension using ideas from field theory and statistical mechanics. Most notably, we identify a local spectral measure of singular continuous type for the disordered model at the Anderson transition. The key mechanism that leads to a singular continuous spectrum is a novel scenario of spontaneous symmetry breaking, intimately connected to the non-compactness of the global symmetry group of the field theory. While that symmetry breaks down to a compact subgroup in the metallic phase, it spontaneously breaks down to a nilpotent subgroup at criticality. We describe the symmetry-breaking extremal states approximately, by applying the self-consistent theory of localization due to Abou-Chacra, Anderson, and Thouless. The thrust of our work is to provide a field-theoretical foundation for disorder phenomena associated with singular continuous spectra.

AI.tldr: 该文利用场论与统计力学方法分析高维 Wegner 单轨道模型的能量谱分解，并在 Anderson 转变处识别出无序模型的奇异连续型局域谱测度。
AI.motivation: 为与奇异连续谱相关的无序现象提供场论基础，并解释 Anderson 转变处奇异连续谱出现的机制。
AI.method: 结合场论与统计力学思想，研究高维 Wegner 单轨道模型的能量谱分解；通过场论全局对称群的非紧致性分析自发对称破缺，并借助 Abou-Chacra–Anderson–Thouless 自洽局域化理论近似描述对称破缺的极端态。
AI.result: 发现奇异连续谱的关键机制是一种新型自发对称破缺：金属相中对称性破缺到紧致子群，而在临界点自发破缺到幂零子群；据此在 Anderson 转变处得到奇异连续型局域谱测度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为奇异连续谱相关的无序现象提供了场论基础，并揭示了非紧致全局对称性及其自发破缺在 Anderson 转变谱性质中的核心作用。

title: Real-Space Theory of Nonequilibrium Orbital Magnetization in Inhomogeneous Solids
summary: We put forward a real-space linear-response theory of orbital magnetization induced by a dc electric field in bulk materials lacking translation invariance. Starting from the current response to a slowly varying electromagnetic field, we show that the linear-in-wavevector conductivity tensor of non-interacting electrons in terms of single-particle Green's functions and the velocity and position operators. This provides a gauge-invariant real-space formulation of the long-wavelength non-equilibrium orbital magnetization of both perfect crystals and disordered systems. In the translationally invariant limit, the formalism recovers the established Bloch picture of orbital magneto-electric effects. We implement the formalism using large-scale Chebyshev expansions and illustrate its capabilities on a Haldane model in the presence of spatially uncorrelated disorder.

AI.tldr: 提出一种实空间线性响应理论，用于描述缺乏平移不变性的体材料中由直流电场诱导的轨道磁化。
AI.motivation: 现有轨道磁电效应理论多依赖Bloch图像和晶格平移对称性，难以处理无序或非周期体系，因此需要规范不变且适用于实空间的长波非平衡轨道磁化理论。
AI.method: 从对缓变电磁场的电流响应出发，用单粒子格林函数以及速度、位置算符表示非相互作用电子的线性于波矢的电导张量，构建规范不变的实空间形式，并用大规模Chebyshev展开实现数值计算。
AI.result: 该形式可统一描述完美晶体与无序体系的长波非平衡轨道磁化；在平移不变极限下恢复已有Bloch轨道磁电效应图像；并在存在空间不相关无序的Haldane模型中展示了计算能力。
AI.conclusion: 工作为无序及缺乏平移不变性体系中的轨道磁电效应提供了规范不变的实空间计算框架，并具备大规模数值应用前景。

title: Towards Defect Engineering of Orbital Magnetoelectric Effects
summary: Orbital magnetization is a fundamental measure of time-reversal symmetry breaking in solids that is accessible by experiments. However, unlike the well-studied equilibrium case, the understanding of orbital magnetism resulting from external stimuli such as light and electric fields is still in its infancy. Here we employ a novel real-space framework to investigate charge-to-orbital conversion in a metallic orbital antiferromagnet beyond the conventional Bloch-band picture. We find that common point defects give rise to strongly enhanced time-odd magnetoelectric effects and, depending on their local symmetry, further activate otherwise-forbidden time-even responses. Moreover, we introduce a local marker that provides spatially resolved information on the orbital magnetization carried by non-equilibrium states. Real-space maps reveal that point defects create nanoscale hotspots of orbital magnetization leading to a profound modification of the bulk magnetoelectric response, including a sign reversal of the net orbital moment. Our findings may open up the possibility of engineering linear-response orbital moments with atomic-scale precision by point defects and impurities.

AI.tldr: 该文用实空间框架研究金属轨道反铁磁体中的电荷-轨道转换，发现点缺陷可显著增强并重构非平衡轨道磁化与磁电响应。
AI.motivation: 轨道磁化是探测固体中时间反演对称性破缺的基本量，但外场（如光、电场）驱动下的轨道磁性理解仍不充分，尤其缺乏超出传统Bloch能带图像的认识。
AI.method: 作者采用新的实空间框架，在金属轨道反铁磁体中研究电荷-轨道转换；分析常见点缺陷对时间奇/时间偶磁电响应的影响，并引入可空间分辨非平衡态轨道磁化的局域标记。
AI.result: 点缺陷强烈增强时间奇磁电效应，并依局域对称性激活原本禁戒的时间偶响应；实空间图显示点缺陷形成纳米尺度轨道磁化热点，显著改变体磁电响应，甚至导致净轨道矩符号反转。
AI.conclusion: 点缺陷和杂质可在原子尺度精确调控线性响应轨道矩，为工程化非平衡轨道磁性提供新途径。

title: Spin dynamics in disordered systems with generic spin-momentum couplings: A matrix-rational formulation
summary: We develop a microscopic framework for the disorder-averaged density-matrix dynamics of pseudospin-$1/2$ systems with anisotropic and nonlinear spin-momentum couplings. Starting from the Diffuson, we introduce a matrix-valued rational approximation for its frequency dependence that does not rely on a low-frequency or weak-coupling expansion. The resulting pole equation is recast as a quadratic eigenvalue problem, from which the real-time evolution of the disorder-averaged density matrix is constructed. We apply the formulation to a two-dimensional electron gas with Rashba and linear and cubic Dresselhaus couplings, a $d$-wave altermagnet with Rashba coupling, and a three-dimensional double-Weyl model. Comparisons with direct numerical simulations demonstrate quantitative agreement for both the post-quench spin dynamics and spin relaxation times across a broad range of coupling strengths, extending beyond the diffusive regime. The matrix-rational formulation provides a unified description of ultrafast spin dynamics and long-time relaxation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Diffuson矩阵有理近似的无序平均密度矩阵动力学框架，可统一描述赝自旋1/2系统中的超快自旋动力学与长时自旋弛豫。
AI.motivation: 现有方法常依赖低频或弱耦合展开，难以处理各向异性、非线性自旋-动量耦合及超出扩散区间的无序自旋动力学。
AI.method: 从Diffuson出发，引入不依赖低频或弱耦合展开的矩阵值有理近似来描述频率依赖；将极点方程转化为二次特征值问题，并由此构造无序平均密度矩阵的实时演化。
AI.result: 应用于含Rashba及线性/立方Dresselhaus耦合的二维电子气、含Rashba耦合的d波交错磁体以及三维双Weyl模型；与直接数值模拟比较，在广泛耦合强度范围内，淬火后自旋动力学和自旋弛豫时间均定量吻合，并超出扩散区间。
AI.conclusion: 矩阵有理形式为超快自旋动力学和长时弛豫提供了统一描述，适用于各向异性、非线性自旋-动量耦合的无序赝自旋系统。

title: Trapped fermions frustrate multiterminal Josephson networks
summary: Coherent control of fermions has become a standard approach for engineering quantum devices. Here, we explore parity-induced frustration in multiterminal Josephson arrays. We focus on odd-parity Josephson trijunctions, where the presence of a trapped fermion induces a phase winding in each trijunction. Connecting these trijunctions constrains their shared phases, resulting in a long-distance phase coherence where the frustrated configurations dominate the low-energy physics. In the classical regime, these arrays map onto the Kagome XY antiferromagnet, whose established Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition yields algebraically decaying $6e$ phase correlations. We show that the $6e$ phase coherence is manifested as a pronounced third harmonic in the current-phase relation of these arrays. While quantum phase fluctuations suppress the $6e$ coherence, we show that through spin-orbit coupling they also lead to spin correlations and entanglement between the trapped fermions. Our results establish fermion-induced frustration as a route to composite superconducting coherence and phase-mediated spin entanglement in superconductor-semiconductor artificial quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多端 Josephson 阵列中由费米子奇宇称诱导的阻挫，并揭示其可产生长程 6e 超导相干及相位介导的自旋纠缠。
AI.motivation: 相干操控费米子是量子器件工程的重要途径，但如何利用俘获费米子诱导的奇宇称阻挫实现复合超导相干与自旋纠缠仍待阐明。
AI.method: 聚焦奇宇称 Josephson 三结，其中俘获费米子使每个三结产生相位绕转；连接三结约束共享相位，使阻挫构型主导低能物理。经典极限下阵列映射为 Kagome XY 反铁磁；并分析电流-相位关系及量子相位涨落、自旋-轨道耦合的影响。
AI.result: 该映射的 BKT 转变给出代数衰减的 6e 相位关联，并在电流-相位关系中表现为显著三次谐波；量子相位涨落抑制 6e 相干，但通过自旋-轨道耦合可产生俘获费米子间的自旋关联与纠缠。
AI.conclusion: 费米子诱导阻挫可作为实现复合超导相干和相位介导自旋纠缠的途径，为超导-半导体人工量子材料提供新机制。

title: Efficient interlayer interactions in non-planar molecule/transition-metal dichalcogenide two-dimensional heterostructure
summary: Integration of molecules and two-dimensional (2D) atomic materials offer new opportunities for hybrid electronic devices. Most progress has focused on interfacing planar molecule. In contrast, incorporating non-planar molecules into 2D heterostructures remains challenging due to the three-dimensional orientations of ligands. Here we investigate interlayer interactions between discrete non-planar spin-crossover (SCO) molecules, [Fe(tBu2qsal)2] (FTBQS), monolayer transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) spacers through optical spectroscopies. FTBQS features bulk molecular crystal layers and can be mechanically exfoliated, enabling deterministic assembly of clean hybrid heterostructures. Robust photoluminescence (PL) quenching, even with an hBN spacer, indicates efficient F\"orster resonance energy transfer with a long decay distance. Gate-dependent optical spectroscopy further identifies charge transfer from the doping shifts in the TMD layers due to the TMD/FTBQS electronic band alignment. Our results establish efficient interlayer interactions between non-plana, discrete molecules and 2D crystals for hybrid electrical, optical, and spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 该工作通过光学光谱研究了非平面自旋交叉分子FTBQS与单层TMD及hBN间隔层之间的层间相互作用，发现存在高效FRET和由能带对齐驱动的电荷转移。
AI.motivation: 多数分子/二维材料杂化研究集中于平面分子；非平面分子因配体具有三维取向，难以集成到二维异质结构中，相关层间相互作用尚不清楚。
AI.method: 利用可机械剥离的FTBQS分子晶体层与单层TMD、hBN间隔层确定性组装清洁杂化异质结构，并采用光致发光等光学光谱及栅压依赖光谱表征层间相互作用。
AI.result: 即使存在hBN间隔层，TMD仍出现显著PL猝灭，表明具有长衰减距离的高效Förster共振能量转移；栅压依赖光谱显示TMD层掺杂位移，归因于TMD/FTBQS能带对齐导致的电荷转移。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了非平面离散分子与二维晶体之间的高效层间相互作用，为基于此类杂化结构的电学、光学和自旋电子器件提供了依据。

title: Two-Dimensional Ferromagnetic Weyl Half-Semimetal
summary: Two-dimensional (2D) ferromagnetic topological materials provide appealing platforms for realizing spin-polarized topological states, yet the coexistence of Weyl fermions and robust high-temperature ferromagnetism remains elusive. Here, based on first-principles calculations and Monte Carlo simulations, we predict monolayer BaMn$_4$O$_8$ to be a dynamically, thermally, and mechanically stable ferromagnetic Weyl half-semimetal. \textcolor{blue}{An anisotropic Monte Carlo simulation on a $20\times20\times1$ lattice yields a finite-size transition estimate of approximately 1446~K.} The spin-resolved electronic structure reveals a fully spin-polarized state, in which the spin-up channel hosts linear Weyl band crossings near the Fermi level, whereas the spin-down channel remains insulating. Corresponding Fermi-arc edge states connecting the projected Weyl points (WPs) are clearly observed along the (100) boundary, confirming the nontrivial topology. Importantly, both the Weyl points and their associated Fermi arcs remain robust in the presence of spin--orbit coupling (SOC). \textcolor{blue}{These results identify monolayer BaMn$_4$O$_8$ as a candidate for fully spin-polarized topological transport.

AI.tldr: 基于第一性原理和蒙特卡罗模拟，预测单层BaMn4O8为动力学、热力学和力学稳定的铁磁Weyl半半金属；其自旋完全极化，Weyl点与费米弧在SOC下仍保持稳健，有限尺寸蒙特卡罗估计转变温度约1446 K。
AI.motivation: 二维铁磁拓扑材料可实现自旋极化拓扑态，但Weyl费米子与稳健高温铁磁性共存仍具挑战。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算与各向异性蒙特卡罗模拟（20×20×1晶格），结合动力学、热力学和力学稳定性分析、自旋分辨电子结构、边界态及自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）计算。
AI.result: 单层BaMn4O8稳定且为铁磁Weyl半半金属：自旋向上通道在费米能级附近具有线性Weyl能带交叉，自旋向下通道绝缘；沿(100)边界观察到连接投影Weyl点的费米弧，且Weyl点和费米弧在SOC下保持稳健；蒙特卡罗有限尺寸转变温度估计约1446 K。
AI.conclusion: 单层BaMn4O8是實現完全自旋极化拓扑输运的有前景候选材料。

title: Breaking the Myth of Four-Tier Stacked Transistors for Logic: an Investigation from Process to Device and Block-Level PPA
summary: For the first time, this work evaluated whether 4-tier stacked transistors can translate the straightforward density gains into realistic chip-level scaling benefits. A practical dual-sided 4-tier transistor-stacking CFFET (Flipped CFET-to-CFET) process was proposed, on which a DTCO framework spanning standard-cell design, local interconnects, RO analysis, and physical implementation was built under 2A node design rules. The CFFET was also benchmarked with its 2-tier transistor-stacking counterparts FFET. Among CFFET configurations, the best-performing Symmetric Power still lags FFET by 11.2% in RO frequency due to the complex MOL parasitics. At the block level, CFFET reduces the Ibex RISC-V core area by only 12.8% (far below the 40% nominal cell-height reduction), while running 10.9% slower at iso-power. We further introduced a novel Tetris-like cell stitching to minimize the area overhead, which allows non-rectangular cell design and recovers 7.4% area in a 1-bit ALU design. An optimized NanoStack CFFET was finally proposed, inspired by previous work. This work indicates that straightforward vertical 4-tier stacking proves insufficient to guarantee enough PPA benefits, though the resulting design insights may guide future advanced architectures.

AI.tldr: 首次在2A节点设计规则下评估4层堆叠晶体管能否将密度增益转化为芯片级PPA收益，发现直接垂直堆叠不足以保证足够收益。
AI.motivation: 4-tier堆叠晶体管的名义密度提升未必能转化为实际芯片级缩放收益，需要系统评估其标准单元、互连、RO和物理实现影响。
AI.method: 提出双面4-tier晶体管堆叠CFFET（Flipped CFET-to-CFET）工艺流程，构建覆盖标准单元设计、局部互连、RO分析和物理实现的DTCO框架，并与2-tier堆叠FFET基准对比；进一步提出Tetris-like cell stitching和优化NanoStack CFFET。
AI.result: 最佳Symorphic Power CFFET因复杂MOL寄生使RO频率仍落后FFET 11.2%；Ibex RISC-V核心面积仅减少12.8%，远低于40%名义单元高度缩减，且等功耗下慢10.9%；Tetris-like非矩形单元拼接在1-bit ALU中回收7.4%面积。
AI.conclusion: 直接的垂直4-tier堆叠不足以确保足够PPA优势，但所得设计洞见可指导未来先进架构。

title: Non-Abelian Hall Effects of Flavor-Waves in $\mathbb{CP}^{2}$ Skyrmions
summary: We investigate the collective excitations of isolated and crystalline $\mathbb{CP}^{2}$ skyrmions in a two-dimensional triangular-lattice spin-1 magnet. Within an $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ coherent-state framework, fluctuations of the magnetic dipole and quadrupole moments are described by two coupled bosonic flavors. In a uniform spin-polarized state, these flavors can be identified with single-spin-flip and double-spin-flip excitations, whereas a nonuniform $\mathbb{CP}^{2}$ texture mixes their character. We formulate the corresponding bosonic Bogoliubov--de Gennes problem and examine the matrix-valued gauge connection governing flavor-wave propagation. For isolated skyrmions, the calculated spectrum contains localized modes, and the scattering dynamics exhibit transverse deflection accompanied by isospin precession. For a numerically relaxed skyrmion crystal, we obtain collective-mode bands with nonzero Chern numbers and calculate the associated thermal Hall response. These findings illustrate how projective magnetic textures couple multipolar excitations to non-Abelian transport and topological band phenomena.

AI.tldr: 研究二维三角晶格自旋-1磁体中孤立及晶态CP^2斯格明子的集体激发，基于SU(3)相干态与玻色BdG框架，揭示局域模、非阿贝尔规范耦合、非零陈数能带及热霍尔响应。
AI.motivation: 自旋-1磁体中的多极激发与CP^2拓扑织构超出传统SU(2)自旋纹理框架，需要理解偶极/四极涨落的耦合、织构诱导的味混合以及拓扑输运。
AI.method: 采用SU(3)相干态将磁偶极与四极矩涨落表示为两个耦合玻色味；在均匀自旋极化态中对应单自旋翻转与双自旋翻转激发，在非均匀CP^2织构中发生混合。构建玻色Bogoliubov-de Gennes问题并分析矩阵值规范连接；对孤立斯格明子计算谱与散射，对数值弛豫的斯格明子晶体计算集体模能带、陈数与热霍尔响应。
AI.result: 孤立CP^2斯格明子谱中存在局域模，散射表现为横向偏转并伴随同位旋进动；斯格明子晶体获得具非零陈数的集体模能带，并产生相应热霍尔响应。
AI.conclusion: 投影磁性织构可将多极激发与非阿贝尔输运及拓扑能带现象耦合起来，为自旋-1磁体中的拓扑多极激发提供统一描述。

title: Spontaneous emission of atomic systems near metallic and semiconducting atomic chains
summary: We investigate the spontaneous emission of a quantum emitter placed near finite atomic chains described by the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model. By tuning the chain from a metallic to a semiconducting character through dimerization, we analyze how the electronic structure of an atomic-scale scatterer, together with the illumination profile, determines the strength, bandwidth, and spatial structure of the spontaneous emission enhancement. The resonant enhancement depends on both spectral matching and the emitter position relative to the induced charge and field patterns. In metallic chains, the nearly harmonic energy spectrum leads to overlapping optical transitions and strong resonances. For semiconducting chains, dimerization opens a gap and leads to a modified density of electronic states, redistributing the response over a broader spectral range and reducing its peak intensity. Coulomb interactions affect the optical resonances through blueshift or modification of their spatial character, and act differently on collective and single-particle-like excitations. Finally, we show that the same mechanisms demonstrated in atomic chains persist in realistic quasi-one-dimensional systems, including trans-polyacetylene chains and graphene nanoribbons. Our findings indicate a general direction for engineering light-matter interactions at the atomic scale, and may offer design principles for tunable nanoscale photonic and quantum-optical devices.

AI.tldr: 研究有限SSH原子链中量子发射体的自发辐射增强，揭示链的二聚化、电子结构、照明分布、位置与库仑相互作用如何共同调控增强的强度、带宽和空间结构，并推广到准一维材料。

AI.method: 将量子发射体置于有限Su-Schrieffer-Heeger原子链附近，通过二聚化使链从金属性调至半导体性，分析光谱匹配、发射体相对诱导电荷与场分布的位置效应，并考察库仑相互作用对光学共振的影响；进一步验证于反式聚乙炔链和石墨烯纳米带等实际准一维体系。
AI.result: 金属链的近谐波能谱导致光学跃迁重叠和强共振；半导体链因二聚化开隙并改变电子态密度，使响应重分布到更宽光谱范围且峰值强度降低。共振增强同时依赖光谱匹配和发射体位置。库仑相互作用可通过蓝移或改变空间特征影响光学共振，且对集体激发和单粒子类激发作用不同。相同机制在反式聚乙炔链和石墨烯纳米带等实际准一维体系中保持。

title: Unified Theory for Momentum-Space Nonsymmorphic Symmetry of Spin Space Groups
summary: Projective crystal symmetry provides a route to nonsymmorphic symmetry structures in momentum space, but a general theory for their realization in spin space groups has been lacking. We show that a nonsymmorphic momentum-space action is possible only when the unitary translation subgroup is combined with rotations about a common axis for a coplanar or noncoplanar spin space group of spin-$1/2$ systems. Its factor system originates entirely from the double cover $\mathrm{Spin}(2)\to SO(2)$, yielding a general formula for the fractional reciprocal-lattice translations and hence for the point-group action on the Brillouin zone. We further prove that a momentum-space nonsymmorphic group is realizable by a spin space group if and only if its Brillouin-zone action contains a two-point orbit. Consequently, 842 of the 1,357 nonsymmorphic magnetic space groups are realizable by spin space groups. Applying this theory, we construct a database covering all 67,475 SSGs that can be queried bidirectionally: from an SSG to its momentum-space magnetic group, or from a given momentum-space magnetic group to all SSGs that realize it. Together, these results establish the momentum-space symmetry foundation for a systematic band theory of SSGs in spin-$1/2$ systems.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了自旋1/2体系中自旋空间群（SSG）在动量空间实现非对称操作的一般理论，并构建了可双向查询的SSG数据库。
AI.motivation: 投影晶体对称可导致动量空间非对称结构，但此前缺乏其在自旋空间群中实现的通用理论。
AI.method: 证明动量空间非对称作用仅当酉平移子群与绕共同轴的旋转结合时可行；其因子系统源于双覆盖Spin(2)→SO(2)，给出分数倒格矢平移及布里渊区点群作用公式；并证明动量空间非对称群可由SSG实现当且仅当其布里渊区作用含二点轨道。
AI.result: 1357个非对称磁空间群中有842个可由SSG实现；构建覆盖全部67,475个SSG的数据库，支持从SSG到其动量空间磁群及反向查询。
AI.conclusion: 结果为自旋1/2体系中SSG的系统性能带理论奠定了动量空间对称性基础。

title: Zero-Temperature Energetics of a First-Order Surface Phase Transition from Diffraction
summary: First-order phase transitions are governed by the balance between zero-temperature energy, thermal vibrational energy, and entropy, yet these contributions are rarely accessible experimentally. Here, we establish a diffraction-based route to determine them for the prototypical Si(111)-In atomic-wire system. From the temperature-dependent Debye-Waller attenuation of reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) intensities we extract distinct Debye temperatures for the low-temperature $(8{\times}2)$ ground state and the high-temperature $(4{\times}1)$ phase. The softer vibrational spectrum of the high-temperature phase yields the entropy gain that stabilizes this phase above the critical temperature $T_\mathrm{c}$. Evaluating the thermodynamic balance between internal energy and entropy at $T_\mathrm{c} = 125\,\mathrm{K}$ yields a zero-temperature energy difference of $\Delta E_0 = 138\,\mathrm{meV}/(8{\times}2)$, including the difference in vibrational zero-point energies of the two phases, thus providing direct access to hidden thermodynamic parameters of a first-order surface phase transition.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用温度依赖的RHEED Debye-Waller衰减，定量提取Si(111)-In原子线体系低温(8×2)与高温(4×1)相的振动热力学参数，并在Tc=125 K处解析出一阶表面相变的内能与熵平衡。
AI.motivation: 一阶相变由零温能量、热振动能量和熵之间的平衡决定，但这些热力学贡献通常难以通过实验直接获得。
AI.method: 基于反射高能电子衍射(RHEED)强度的温度依赖Debye-Waller衰减，提取低温(8×2)基态和高温(4×1)相的不同Debye温度，并由此推导高温相较软振动谱带来的熵增益及相变处的热力学平衡。
AI.result: 高温(4×1)相的较软振动谱提供熵增益，使其在临界温度以上稳定；在Tc=125 K处评估内能与熵平衡，得到零温能量差ΔE0=138 meV/(8×2)，其中包含两相振动零点能之差。
AI.conclusion: 该衍射方法可直接获取一阶表面相变中隐藏的热力学参数，为实验定量解析零温能量、振动能量与熵的竞争提供途径。

title: Analytical Interacting Tight-binding Model for Fractional Chern Insulators
summary: We construct a two-dimensional 2-band tight-binding model with two-body interactions and without magnetic lattice translation, in which both the hopping and interaction are exponentially local (with Gaussian decay) in real space. The interaction is built from pair annihilation operators whose coefficients are hopping amplitudes divided by positive powers of relative distance. Without any band projection, the ground states at $1/3$ filling are exactly fractional Chern insulator (FCI) states (and thus have nonzero gap) for any finite lattice size with any periodic/twist boundary conditions. The FCI ground states are analogous to the discretized version of the Laughlin-like states in the continuum Chern-ideal band, though our FCI states do not require the onsite spinor structure that is necessary in the continuum. We further show analytically that, after adding one unit cell while keeping electron number fixed, the anyonic one-quasihole states are zero-energy ground states of the full Hamiltonian for any finite system size and any quasihole position, analogous to Laughlin quasiholes under the Haldane $V_1$ pseudopotential. Numerical evidence is provided for the possible nonzero gap of the FCI states at $1/3$ filling in the thermodynamic limit, when interaction strength is much smaller than the single-particle band gap.

AI.tldr: 该文构造了一个二维两带紧束缚模型，在无磁格子平移、无需能带投影的条件下，于1/3填充给出精确的分数量子陈绝缘体（FCI）基态，并证明单准空穴为零能任意子激发。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建类似连续Chern-ideal能带中Laughlin态的可精确求解FCI模型，避免依赖能带投影、磁格子平移以及连续模型中必要的 onsite spinor 结构。
AI.method: 采用二维两带紧束缚模型并引入两体相互作用；跃迁与相互作用在实空间均呈高斯型指数局域，相互作用由配对湮灭算符构成，其系数为跃迁振幅除以相对距离的正幂次；结合解析证明与数值计算研究有限尺寸基态、准空穴及热力学极限能隙。
AI.result: 在1/3填充下，对任意有限晶格尺寸及任意周期/扭转边界条件，基态无需能带投影即为精确FCI态且具有非零能隙；固定电子数并增加一个原胞后，任意位置的单准空穴态均为全哈密顿量的零能基态，类似Haldane V1赝势下的Laughlin准空穴；数值证据表明当相互作用强度远小于单粒子能带隙时，FCI态能隙在热力学极限下可能非零。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了具有精确FCI基态和任意子准空穴的父哈密顿量，为分数量子陈绝缘体的精确构造与稳定性提供了新范例。

title: Observation of room-temperature intrinsic antiferroelectricity in van der Waals NbOCl2
summary: In recent years, two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectricity has been extensively investigated across a wide range of 2D materials, while intrinsic 2D antiferroelectricity remains exceptionally rare, limiting its implementation in next-generation photonic and electronic devices. Here, we report the observation of room-temperature-stable antiferroelectricity in the layered transition metal oxyhalide NbOCl2, and demonstrate a reversible, stimuli-driven antiferroelectric-to-ferroelectric (AFE-to-FE) phase transition in this material. Second-harmonic generation (SHG) mapping reveals a well-defined stripe-like spatial distribution of SHG intensity across as-grown NbOCl2 flakes spanning thickness from few-layer to bulk-like configurations. This distinctive SHG signature originates from the existence of antiferroelectric phase and the coexistence of antiferroelectric and ferroelectric phases within individual crystals, as evidenced by a combined incident-angle-dependent SHG measurement and Raman spectroscopy. By integrating NbOCl2 with one-dimensional silver nanowires, we achieve spatially selective, strain-mediated AFE-to-FE phase transition. Moreover, an ultralow electric field (~20 kV/cm) induces a reversible SHG response, consistent with switching from the centrosymmetric antiferroelectric state (SHG-silent) to the non-centrosymmetric ferroelectric state (SHG-active). This study not only expands the family of room-temperature 2D antiferroelectrics but also establishes a versatile platform for dynamic manipulation of nonlinear light, paving the way toward electric-field-programmable nonlinear photonics and optical information processing.

AI.tldr: 该文报道层状过渡金属氧卤化物NbOCl2中室温稳定的本征二维反铁电性，并实现刺激驱动的可逆反铁电-铁电（AFE-to-FE）相变。
AI.motivation: 本征二维反铁电材料极其罕见，限制了其在下一代光子与电子器件中的应用；作者旨在拓展室温二维反铁电体系并实现动态非线性光学调控。
AI.method: 结合二次谐波产生（SHG）面扫描、入射角依赖SHG与拉曼光谱表征NbOCl2薄片中的反铁电相及AFE/FE共存；将NbOCl2与一维银纳米线集成，利用应变实现空间选择性AFE-to-FE相变，并用超低电场（约20 kV/cm）诱导可逆SHG响应。
AI.result: 观测到as-grown NbOCl2薄片具有明确的条纹状SHG强度分布，源于反铁电相及AFE/FE共存；Ag纳米线应变可实现空间选择性相变；约20 kV/cm电场可使中心对称反铁电态（SHG静默）与非中心对称铁电态（SHG活跃）之间可逆切换。

title: Exact Parent Hamiltonians for Partially Magnetized Chiral Spin Liquids
summary: Chiral spin liquids (CSLs) are paradigmatic fractionalized phases, yet simple exact parent Hamiltonians for them remain scarce. In this work, we construct exact spin parent Hamiltonians for partially magnetized CSLs realizing various bosonic topological orders. Our construction relies on an exact Hubbard-type parent Hamiltonian for bosonic lattice fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states, valid at arbitrary repulsive interaction strengths. Taking the on-site repulsion to infinity and applying local boson-spin mappings yields exact parent Hamiltonians for the CSLs. Our two-spin construction generalizes the Kalmeyer-Laughlin spin Hamiltonian to a broader class of bosonic FQH model states, including Abelian states and non-Abelian parton states. We derive controlled microscopic realizations of these two-spin Hamiltonians via second-order superexchange in generalized spinful Hofstadter-Hubbard models with tailored hoppings and interactions. With more general local constraints and interactions, boson-spin mappings yield exact higher-spin and multispin parent Hamiltonians for partially magnetized CSLs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种构造部分磁化手性自旋液体（CSL）精确母哈密顿量的系统方案：以玻色晶格分数量子霍尔态的Hubbard型母哈密顿量和局域玻色子-自旋映射为核心，并给出超交换微观实现及高阶推广。
AI.motivation: CSL是重要的分数化相，但简单且精确的母哈密顿量仍很稀缺；作者希望为部分磁化CSL及多种玻色拓扑序提供可解析、可微观实现的精确自旋模型。
AI.method: 先构造对任意排斥强度都成立的玻色晶格FQH态精确Hubbard型母哈密顿量；将在位排斥取无穷并应用局域玻色子-自旋映射，得到CSL的精确自旋母哈密顿量；进一步在具有定制跃迁和相互作用的广义自旋Hofstadter-Hubbard模型中通过二阶超交换实现两自旋哈密顿量；并利用更一般的局域约束和相互作用推广到高阶自旋与多自旋情形。
AI.result: 构造出实现多种玻色拓扑序的部分磁化CSL精确自旋母哈密顿量；两自旋构造将Kalmeyer-Laughlin自旋哈密顿量推广到更广的玻色FQH模型态，包括Abelian态和非Abelian parton态；给出这些两自旋哈密顿量的可控微观实现，并获得部分磁化CSL的精确higher-spin和multispin母哈密顿量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为部分磁化CSL提供了系统的精确模型与微观实现路径，将Kalmeyer-Laughlin框架扩展到更广泛的玻色拓扑序，并表明玻色子-自旋映射是构造精确自旋母哈密顿量的有效工具。

title: Cross-probing van der Waals multiferroics
summary: Multiferroic materials, with coupled electric and magnetic orders, hold the potential to enable low-power memory and logic devices by replacing electrical currents with electric fields for magnetic switching. Reducing the dimensionality of multiferroics, from 3D to 2D, has opened new frontiers in this already burgeoning field by enabling unprecedented control over magnetoelectric coupling that is beyond the reach of bulk counterparts, owing to reduced electrostatic screening and enhanced quantum fluctuations at the atomically thin limit. A notable example is a few-layer NiI2 multiferroic, which exhibits coexisting chiral spin textures and (anti)ferroelectricity, accompanied by strong magnetoelectric coupling; by simultaneously breaking time-reversal and spatial-inversion symmetry, NiI2 shows new physical properties such as unique mutual control of chiral magnetism and polarization with giant magnetoelectric coupling, ultrafast electromagnon excitations and odd-parity p-wave magnetism. However, there are experimental challenges in unambiguously identifying intrinsic multiferroicity. This Review critically examines the current landscape of 2D multiferroic materials, with an emphasis on experimental methodologies rather than material taxonomy. We assess different conventional probes for magnetism and ferroelectricity and identify key limitations in single-technique approaches. We emphasize the importance of magneto-opto-electric cross-correlative measurements in establishing intrinsic multiferroic behaviour and outline future research directions for both fundamental studies and device applications.

AI.tldr: 该综述聚焦二维多铁材料，强调以磁-光-电交叉关联测量确证本征多铁性，而非仅做材料分类。
AI.motivation: 多铁材料通过电场替代电流实现磁翻转，有望用于低功耗存储与逻辑器件；将多铁性从三维降至二维可借助减弱静电屏蔽和增强量子涨落获得超越块体的磁电耦合调控。少层NiI2同时具有手性自旋织构与（反）铁电性及强磁电耦合，但本征多铁性的实验判定仍存在挑战。
AI.method: 批判性审视当前二维多铁材料研究格局，重点讨论实验方法学而非材料 taxonomy；评估磁性与铁电性的常规探测手段，指出单一技术路径的关键局限；强调磁-光-电交叉关联测量在建立本征多铁行为中的重要性，并展望基础研究与器件应用方向。
AI.result: 少层NiI2展示共存的手性自旋织构与（反）铁电性、强磁电耦合，并因同时打破时间反演与空间反演对称性而呈现手性磁性与极化互控、巨大磁电耦合、超快电振子激发及奇宇称p波磁性等新物理；然而无歧义识别本征多铁性仍具实验挑战。
AI.conclusion: 确立二维本征多铁性需要采用磁-光-电交叉关联测量以克服单技术局限；该方向对基础物理理解和低功耗磁电器件应用均具有重要意义。

title: Towards Cryogenic AI Hardware: Over 99% Precision In-Memory Computing at 4 K with 3-bit Ferroelectric Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 Capacitors
summary: High-accuracy cryogenic hyperdimensional computing (HDC) is demonstrated using Hf0.5Zr0.5O2 (HZO) ferroelectric capacitors (FeCAPs) as multilevel analog memories for capacitive compute in-memory (CIM) architectures. On the ISOLET spoken-word dataset, FeCAP-stored vectors achieve up to 92% classification accuracy at 4 K, while charge-domain matrix-vector multiplication (MVM) exhibits near-ideal behaviour with linearity of 1 and error probability below 1% for 4x4 and 4x8 configurations, operating below 3 V. Unlike the performance at 300 K, HDC and CIM at 4 K remains resilient to electric-field-cycling-induced fatigue, thanks to enhanced cryogenic device characteristics, including reduced state variability, strongly suppressed leakage current and stable retention, as well as 78% faster switching. Furthermore, these multibit FeCAPs exhibit endurance beyond 1E9 cycles with polarization degradation below 8%, preserving multilevel integrity. Benefits can also be observed at 300 K, following cooldown and wake-up pulsing at 4 K and subsequent warming up. These results establish multibit FeCAPs as a highly reliable, ultra-low-energy, and accurate analog CIM platform for future cryogenic AI-computing hardware.

AI.tldr: 利用HZO铁电电容器（FeCAP）作为多电平模拟存储器，在低温下实现高精度超维计算（HDC）与电容式存内计算（CIM）。
AI.motivation: 面向未来低温AI计算硬件，需要兼具高精度、低能耗和高可靠性的模拟CIM平台；研究FeCAP在4 K低温下的HDC与CIM性能及耐久性。
AI.method: 采用Hf0.5Zr0.5O2（HZO）FeCAP构建多比特模拟记忆，用于电容式CIM中的电荷域矩阵-向量乘法（MVM），并在ISOLET口语词数据集上评估4 K下HDC分类性能，同时测试线性度、误码率、疲劳、保持性和耐久性。
AI.result: 在4 K下HDC分类准确率最高达92%；4x4和4x8 MVM近理想，线性度为1，误差概率低于1%，工作电压低于3 V；4 K下对电场循环疲劳更具鲁棒性，得益于状态变异降低、漏电流抑制、保持稳定及开关速度提升78%；多比特FeCAP耐久性超过1E9次循环，极化退化低于8%；经4 K冷却与唤醒脉冲后升温至300 K仍可获益。
AI.conclusion: 多比特HZO FeCAP可作为高可靠、超低能耗且高精度的模拟CIM平台，适用于未来低温AI计算硬件。

title: Predicting solid-state reaction onset temperatures from high-throughput pairwise synthesis
summary: Solid-state synthesis still relies on heuristics to choose reaction temperatures. The most widely used, Tammann's rule, places reaction onset at two-thirds of the lowest precursor melting point, but has never been systematically tested. Using an automated laboratory, we heated 1,035 pairwise combinations of 46 common precursors at their Tammann temperatures and identified the products by x-ray diffraction. Only 25% of pairs formed products containing both precursors. Combining these outcomes with text-mined literature syntheses, we trained log-normal accelerated failure time models that treat each fixed-temperature experiment as a bound on the unknown onset temperature. On 26 reactions with onset temperatures measured by in situ x-ray diffraction, a three-descriptor model reduced the mean absolute error from 131{\deg}C (Tammann's rule) to 88{\deg}C; adding 29 further physicochemical descriptors did not improve the model. Reaction onset can therefore be predicted from routine pass/fail synthesis outcomes, and predictions will improve as such data accumulates.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统检验了固态合成中常用的Tammann规则，并证明反应起始温度可由常规的成败型合成结果预测。
AI.motivation: 固态合成反应温度长期依赖启发式规则，尤其是Tammann规则（取最低前驱体熔点的三分之二），但该规则从未被系统验证。
AI.method: 利用自动化实验室将46种常见前驱体的1,035个两两组合加热至各自Tammann温度，并用X射线衍射鉴定产物；结合文本挖掘的文献合成数据，训练对数正态加速失效时间模型，将每个固定温度实验视为对未知起始温度的约束。
AI.result: 仅25%的组合形成了同时包含两种前驱体的产物；在26个用原位X射线衍射测得起始温度的反应上，三描述符模型将平均绝对误差从Tammann规则的131°C降至88°C，而增加29个物理化学描述符未带来改进。
AI.conclusion: 反应起始温度可从常规的通过/失败合成结果中预测，且随着此类数据积累，预测性能有望进一步提升。

title: Application of Pretrained Universal Machine Learning Force-Fields for Phase Transitions Prediction in ZrO2
summary: Pretrained universal machine-learning force fields can reduce the cost of finite-temperature molecular dynamics relative to density functional theory. However, most benchmarks test only static properties and do not assess whether these models reproduce the correct phase-transition sequence. Here, we benchmark ten open-source universal machine-learning force fields for zirconia (ZrO$_2$) using phonon dispersion calculations and variable-cell isothermal-isobaric molecular dynamics. Zirconia is a useful test because it has three thermodynamically stable crystalline phases prior to melting, following the sequence monoclinic-tetragonal-cubic. Four models reproduce this sequence: 7net-l3i5, MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M, MACE-mpa, and MACE-D3. Models with orthorhombic-tetragonal energy errors above about 10 meV/atom (7net-0, CHGNet, and MACE) instead produce an orthorhombic intermediate and predict monoclinic-orthorhombic-tetragonal-cubic-liquid upon heating. ORB-based models fail to sustain stable variable-cell dynamics because their phonon frequencies are compressed by 30-60% relative to the density functional theory reference. Across all ten models, two ground-state diagnostics predict finite-temperature behavior. Relative polymorph energetics should agree with the matched density functional theory reference within about 6 meV/atom, and the phonon spectrum should not show systematic softening. These diagnostics are practical screening metrics for assessing pretrained force fields for phase-transition predictions.

AI.tldr: 该文用声子色散和变胞NPT分子动力学基准测试10个开源通用机器学习力场对ZrO2相变序列的预测能力，并识别出可预测有限温度行为的基态诊断指标。
AI.motivation: 预训练通用机器学习力场可降低有限温度分子动力学相对DFT的成本，但现有基准多只测静态性质，未评估其能否重现正确相变序列。
AI.method: 以ZrO2为测试体系，对10个开源通用机器学习力场进行声子色散计算和变胞等温等压分子动力学模拟，并与DFT参考比较；ZrO2在熔化前具有单斜-四方-立方三个热力学稳定晶相。
AI.result: 7net-l3i5、MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M、MACE-mpa和MACE-D3四个模型重现单斜-四方-立方序列；正交-四方能量误差约高于10 meV/atom的7net-0、CHGNet和MACE产生正交中间相，预测为单斜-正交-四方-立方-液体；ORB类模型声子频率相对DFT压缩30-60%，无法维持稳定变胞动力学。相对多晶型能量与DFT参考误差约在6 meV/atom以内且声子谱无系统性软化，可预测有限温度行为。
AI.conclusion: 相对多晶型 energetics 和声子谱软化是筛选预训练力场相变预测能力的实用基态诊断指标。

title: Fast closed-loop STEM navigation using vision-language models with typed decisions
summary: Closed-loop scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), in which each acquired image determines the next field of view and magnification, offers a route to autonomous atomic-scale materials analysis. Such a loop would automate navigation to defects and grain boundaries, a task that has long relied on operator judgment, and would enable systematic analysis of diverse local structures at scale. Realizing it hinges on the decision step, which must translate each acquired image into the next operation both quickly and correctly; yet which decision method can deliver both remains unclear. Here, we isolate this decision step. Using simulated atomic-resolution STEM images of a substitutional W dopant and a grain boundary in monolayer MoS$_2$, where the true target position is known and every method starts from identical conditions, we compared four vision-language models (VLMs) and three decision methods. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of Typed Decision, which directly obtains the probabilities of candidate labels from a pretrained VLM, for closed-loop STEM navigation. Typed Decision showed the shortest decision latency for all models (0.13-0.21 s) and generally achieved the highest navigation success rate among the three methods: it was the best for all models in W dopant navigation (66-91%) and for the best-performing model, Cosmos-Reason2 32B, in grain boundary navigation (43%). Furthermore, navigation to the different targets, the W dopant and the grain boundary, was possible by natural-language specification alone, without task-specific training of the VLM. These results indicate that Typed Decision is an effective decision method for realizing fast, accurate, and flexible closed-loop STEM.

AI.tldr: 该文聚焦闭环STEM中的决策环节，在已知真值的模拟原子分辨率图像上比较4种视觉语言模型与3种决策方法，发现Typed Decision在决策延迟和导航成功率上整体最优，可实现快速、准确且灵活的自主导航。
AI.motivation: 闭环扫描透射电子显微镜需要根据每张图像决定下一视野与放大倍数，从而自动导航至缺陷和晶界；但关键决策步骤必须同时快速且正确，现有决策方法能否兼顾尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用单层MoS2中替代式W掺杂剂和晶界的模拟原子分辨率STEM图像，所有方法从相同初始条件出发且目标位置已知；比较4种视觉语言模型（VLMs）和3种决策方法，并隔离评估决策步骤。
AI.result: Typed Decision直接从预训练VLM获取候选标签概率，在所有模型上决策延迟最短（0.13–0.21 s），并在三种方法中总体取得最高导航成功率：W掺杂剂导航中对所有模型均为最佳（66–91%），晶界导航中对最佳模型Cosmos-Reason2 32B达到43%；且仅通过自然语言指定目标即可导航至不同目标，无需任务特定训练。
AI.conclusion: Typed Decision是面向闭环STEM导航的有效决策方法，可支持快速、准确和灵活的自主原子尺度材料分析。

title: Physics-Guided Crystal Structure Elucidation from Powder X-Ray Diffraction with Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Determining unique atomic coordinates from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) remains challenging because peak overlap, weak scattering from light elements, limited scattering contrast between elements with similar atomic numbers, and experimental noise render the inverse problem underdetermined. Here, we present XCAPE (XRD-Constrained Accelerated Prediction Engine), a crystal structure prediction (CSP) framework that integrates experimentally derived composition, unit cell parameters, space group, and PXRD data into a symmetry-aware evolutionary search. XCAPE explores Wyckoff-site configurations using tailored mutation operations, evaluates candidates by both energetic stability and diffraction agreement, and accelerates geometry optimization using a universal machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP). The framework recovered 71 of 77 database-derived benchmark structures (92.2%) from simulated PXRD patterns and all 12 reference structures from experimental PXRD patterns. It further identified 12 candidate structure assignments that are consistent with experimental PXRD patterns, lack matching entries in the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD), and are thermodynamically competitive at the MLIP level. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations showed that 10 of these 12 candidates lie within 10 meV/atom of the convex hull. By bridging experimental diffraction data and physically plausible atomistic models, XCAPE can provide structural insight into previously unresolved materials and support accelerated materials discovery in automated research workflows.

AI.tldr: XCAPE 是一个将实验 PXRD 数据与对称性感知进化搜索相结合的晶体结构预测框架，可从粉末衍射数据中反推原子坐标并发现候选新结构。
AI.motivation: 仅凭 PXRD 确定唯一原子坐标仍是欠定逆问题，原因包括峰重叠、轻元素弱散射、相似原子序数元素散射对比度低以及实验噪声。
AI.method: XCAPE 将实验得到的组成、晶胞参数、空间群和 PXRD 数据整合到对称性感知进化搜索中；通过定制变异操作探索 Wyckoff 位点构型，以能量稳定性和衍射一致性评估候选结构，并用通用机器学习原子间势加速几何优化。
AI.result: 在模拟 PXRD 基准中恢复 77 个结构中的 71 个（92.2%），并从实验 PXRD 中恢复全部 12 个参考结构；还识别出 12 个与实验 PXRD 一致、ICSD 无匹配且 MLIP 层面热力学有竞争力的候选结构，其中 DFT 显示 10 个位于凸包 10 meV/atom 以内。
AI.conclusion: XCAPE 桥接实验衍射数据与物理合理的原子模型，可为未解析材料提供结构 insight，并支持自动化研究流程中的加速材料发现。

title: Materials representations organize transferable supervision for chemical extrapolation
summary: Materials discovery often requires chemical extrapolation beyond labeled data. When target compounds contain elements absent from training, which compounds of other elements provide transferable supervision remains unclear. Here we show that, without target-property labels, materials representations rank other elements by the supervision their compounds provide. Engineered descriptors rank them largely by elemental-property similarity, whereas a pretrained crystal-graph encoder ranks them by the geometry of its learned representation. At fixed training-set size, excluding the compounds of the encoder's six top-ranked elements raises formation-energy and bandgap errors by 100-110 meV per atom and 42-85 meV, versus little change for six lower-ranked elements. The rankings hold across properties, regressors and datasets. The encoder's ranking outperforms elemental-property similarity and periodic groups, suggesting that it captures how elements behave within compounds. Materials representations thus organize transferable supervision, which can be identified before model training, informing dataset assessment and label acquisition.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，无需目标性质标签，材料表征即可对其它元素的化合物所提供的可迁移监督进行排序；预训练晶体图编码器的排序能识别对训练更关键的元素。
AI.motivation: 材料发现常需在标注数据之外进行化学外推；当目标化合物含训练集中未出现的元素时，哪些其它元素化合物能提供可迁移监督尚不明确。
AI.method: 利用材料表征在无目标性质标签下对元素进行监督可迁移性排序，比较工程描述符与预训练晶体图编码器；在固定训练集规模下，分别排除编码器排名前六和后六元素的化合物，评估形成能与带隙误差，并跨性质、回归器和数据集验证。
AI.result: 排除编码器前六元素化合物使形成能误差增加100–110 meV/atom、带隙误差增加42–85 meV，而排除较低排名六元素影响很小；该排序跨性质、回归器和数据集稳定，且优于元素性质相似性和周期族分组。
AI.conclusion: 材料表征能够组织可迁移监督，且可在模型训练前识别关键元素与数据，从而指导数据集评估和标签获取。

title: Tuning spreading transport in GaN HEMTs with an AlN space layer under non-equilibrium heating
summary: Lateral spreading transport dominates near-junction heat dissipation in GaN high-electron-mobility transistors, yet thermal control has largely overlooked this geometry. It neither reaches the core AlGaN/GaN region nor, beyond the spatial spreading itself, accounts for the spectral non-equilibrium of the heat source. Here we tune the spreading resistance directly by inserting a thin, highly conducting AlN space layer above the source to intercept heat and divert it laterally. We test this approach across GaN, AlGaN/GaN, and AlGaN/AlN/GaN structures under both equilibrium and longitudinal-optical (LO)-pumped non-equilibrium heating, pairing non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) with full-band phonon Monte Carlo (MC). In equilibrium, the AlN layer lowers the spreading resistance by 38% relative to the AlGaN-capped structure and by 17% relative to bare GaN, with little change in the one-dimensional resistance. The equilibrium color map over AlN thickness and interfacial bonding shows a strong interface effect but a weak thickness trend that reverses, so the gain is set by interface admission rather than solely by thickness or bulk conductivity. This ordering is independently confirmed by gray MC simulations. Under LO pumping, the spreading resistance rises by 58-83% in NEMD and by 9-20% in MC, and the equilibrium spatial optimum weakens or even reverses. This is because an optical-to-acoustic conversion gate now precedes every spatial gate and locks energy in slow optical modes. The three gates in series (optical-to-acoustic conversion, interface admission, and lateral diversion) close into a single non-equilibrium resistance network that predicts the full-band MC cases and frames the AlN space layer as a design variable within the non-equilibrium source state.

AI.tldr: 通过插入薄AlN空间层调控源极上方横向扩展热阻，并结合NEMD与全带声子MC揭示平衡与LO泵浦非平衡条件下的近结传热机制。
AI.motivation: GaN HEMT近结散热以横向扩展为主，但热管理长期忽视该几何；现有控制既未覆盖核心AlGaN/GaN区，也未在空间扩展之外考虑热源的光谱非平衡。
AI.method: 在源极上方插入高导热薄AlN空间层以截获热量并横向分流；针对GaN、AlGaN/GaN和AlGaN/AlN/GaN结构，在平衡与LO泵浦非平衡加热下，采用NEMD与全带声子MC模拟扩展热阻及AlN厚度、界面键合的影响。
AI.result: 平衡态下AlN层使扩展热阻较AlGaN帽层降低38%、较裸GaN降低17%，一维热阻几乎不变；界面效应强而厚度趋势弱且可反转，灰体MC独立确认该排序。LO泵浦下NEMD扩展热阻升高58–83%、MC升高9–20%，平衡态空间最优减弱甚至反转，原因是光声转换门先于空间门并锁定能量于慢光学模。
AI.conclusion: 光声转换、界面准入与横向分流串联构成非平衡热阻网络，可预测全带MC结果；AlN空间层应作为非平衡热源状态下的设计变量，而非仅由厚度或体导热决定。

title: Technical Note on Matlantis PFP v9: Extending the Element and Domain Coverage of the r2SCAN Training Data
summary: Universal machine learning interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) make atomistic simulations possible at scales beyond the reach of density functional theory (DFT). Matlantis PFP is a uMLIP that treats a variety of domains, including crystals, molecules, and surfaces, with a single model. PFP v8 incorporated a training dataset computed with the r2SCAN functional, chosen for its good agreement with experiment, but the elements and domains covered by that dataset were limited. Here we present Matlantis PFP v9, in which the training data computed with the r2SCAN functional are extended to the lanthanides from Pr to Lu and to the elements from Po to Cm, for a total of 96 elements, and to additional domains such as clusters and adsorption structures. The formation energies of crystals containing the newly supported elements reproduce experimental standard enthalpies of formation with the same level of accuracy as crystals composed only of previously supported elements, and the adsorption energies of molecules on transition-metal surfaces have an overall error against experiment comparable to that of DFT-PBE, although chemisorbed species are overbound. On the same type of GPU (A100), the inference speed and the maximum system size exceed those of SevenNet-Omni, a public uMLIP trained on r2SCAN data: forces are evaluated three to four times faster, and five to ten times as many atoms can be handled. As a result, PFP-R2SCAN is now applicable to systems containing rare-earth and actinide elements and to adsorption on surfaces.

AI.tldr: Matlantis PFP v9 将基于 r2SCAN 的通用机器学习原子间势扩展到 96 种元素，并新增团簇与吸附结构等域；其形成能精度与实验相当，吸附能误差接近 DFT-PBE，且在 A100 上比 SevenNet-Omni 更快、可处理更大体系。
AI.motivation: DFT 难以覆盖大尺度原子模拟，而现有 uMLIP（如 PFP v8）虽采用与实验吻合较好的 r2SCAN 数据，但元素和结构域覆盖有限，尤其缺少稀土/锕系元素及吸附等应用场景。
AI.method: 构建 Matlantis PFP v9：在 PFP v8 的 r2SCAN 训练数据基础上，将元素覆盖扩展至 Pr 到 Lu 的镧系以及 Po 到 Cm，共 96 种元素，并加入团簇、吸附结构等额外域，以单一模型处理晶体、分子和表面等。
AI.result: 含新支持元素的晶体形成能可复现实验标准生成焓，精度与仅含旧元素晶体相当；分子在过渡金属表面的吸附能总体误差与 DFT-PBE 相当，但化学吸附物种存在过结合。相同 A100 GPU 上，其推理速度约为 SevenNet-Omni 的 3–4 倍（力评估），最大体系规模可大 5–10 倍。
AI.conclusion: PFP-R2SCAN 现已可应用于含稀土和锕系元素的体系以及表面吸附问题，并在精度与效率上具备竞争力，但化学吸附过结合仍需注意。

title: Light-Induced Odd-Parity h-Wave Magnetism in Penrose Quasicrystals
summary: Noncrystallographic rotational symmetry offers a route to unconventional spin splitting beyond the constraints of periodic crystals. We show that circularly polarized light induces odd-parity $h$-wave magnetism in a collinear antiferromagnetic Penrose quasicrystal without spin-orbit coupling. Light-induced chiral hopping, generated by virtual two-step processes, combines with staggered exchange to lift the spin degeneracy of the undriven system. Quasicrystalline spin-group symmetry enforces odd-parity spin splitting and selects $h$-wave as its leading angular harmonic. An analytical effective quasi-band theory relates this splitting to the geometry of local hopping paths and predicts its reversal upon switching the light helicity. Momentum-resolved spectral calculations reveal the characteristic alternating spin contrast, for which we propose spin-resolved time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy as an experimental probe. Our results establish a mechanism for optically controlling higher-harmonic odd-parity magnetism and demonstrate how quasicrystalline order extends Floquet engineering beyond crystallographic symmetry constraints.

AI.tldr: 在无自旋轨道耦合的共线反铁磁Penrose准晶中，圆偏振光通过虚两步过程诱导手性跃迁，与交错交换作用结合，产生奇宇称h波磁性和交替自旋劈裂，并可通过切换光螺旋度反转。
AI.motivation: 突破周期晶体对称性限制，利用非晶体学旋转对称实现非常规自旋劈裂，并探索光学调控高阶奇宇称磁性的机制。
AI.method: 构建共线反铁磁Penrose准晶模型；由虚两步过程导出光致手性跃迁并结合交错交换作用；利用准晶自旋群对称性确定奇宇称h波为主导角谐波；建立有效准带理论并进行动量分辨谱计算。
AI.result: 圆偏振光在无自旋轨道耦合下诱导奇宇称h波磁性并解除自旋简并；h波为领先角谐波；自旋劈裂与局域跃迁路径几何相关，且随光螺旋度切换而反转；动量分辨谱显示特征性交替自旋衬度。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种光学控制高阶奇宇称磁性的机制，表明准晶序可将Floquet工程拓展到晶体学对称约束之外，并建议用自旋分辨时间分辨和角分辨光电子能谱进行实验探测。

title: Ultrafast Successive Control and Electrical Detection of Long-Lived Valley Polarization in Room-Temperature Germanium
summary: Germanium (Ge) hosts four degenerate valleys in the conduction band minima, and their highly anisotropic effective masses offer a valley degree of freedom in transport phenomena via anisotropic conductivity. Using time- and polarization-resolved terahertz spectroscopy combined with deformation potential theory, we reveal a valley relaxation time reaching 10 ps near the band edge of Ge(001) at room temperature, long enough to detect the valley polarization in electrical transport measurements. We also demonstrate sub-picosecond complete reversal of valley polarization by off-resonant light pulses at extremely low energy consumption. These results pave the way for room-temperature valleytronics based on bulk indirect-gap semiconductors compatible with existing electronics.

AI.tldr: 该工作利用时间与偏振分辨太赫兹光谱结合形变势理论，在室温Ge(001)中观测到近带边约10 ps的谷弛豫时间，并实现亚皮秒、超低能耗的谷极化完全反转。
AI.motivation: 锗导带存在四个简并谷，其高度各向异性的有效质量使各向异性电导率可承载谷自由度，有望实现与现有电子学兼容的室温谷电子学。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨和偏振分辨太赫兹光谱，并结合形变势理论分析Ge(001)中的谷极化动力学。
AI.result: 测得室温近带边谷弛豫时间可达约10 ps，足以通过电输运测量探测谷极化；并利用极低能量的非共振光脉冲实现亚皮秒级谷极化完全反转。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明体态间接带隙半导体Ge可在室温下支持可探测、可超快调控的谷极化，为兼容现有电子器件的室温谷电子学奠定基础。

title: Two-Color Coherent Control of the Spin Photovoltaic Effect in Centrosymmetric Crystals
summary: Spatial inversion forbids the conventional electric-dipole second-order bulk charge and spin photovoltaic responses in centrosymmetric crystals. Here we show that a phase-coherent two-color field at frequencies $\omega$ and $2\omega$ can generate symmetry-selected charge and spin photocurrents through an inversion-even third-order dc response. More importantly, the polarization direction and relative phase of the two-color field provide direct control over the current direction and can isolate transport channels in which the charge current vanishes while a finite spin current remains. A systematic symmetry analysis of centrosymmetric magnetic point groups and collinear antiferromagnetic spin point groups shows that pure-spin channels are allowed in a broad class of such systems under appropriate two-color driving. Furthermore, the relative optical phase governs both the magnitude and sign of the response. Our calculations on inversion-stacked bilayer 2H-MoS$_2$ and a centrosymmetric collinear altermagnet demonstrate resonantly enhanced, phase-tunable spin photocurrents in these complementary systems with strong and weak spin-orbit coupling, respectively. Our results establish the polarization direction and phase of coherent two-color light as active control parameters for spin transport in centrosymmetric materials.

AI.tldr: 利用ω与2ω相位相干双色光激发中心对称晶体中的反演偶三阶直流响应，可实现对称性选择的电荷与自旋光电流，并通过偏振方向和相对相位调控电流方向、隔离纯自旋输运通道。
AI.motivation: 空间反演对称性通常禁止常规电偶极二阶体电荷与自旋光伏响应，因此需要寻找在中心对称材料中产生并调控自旋光电流的新机制。
AI.method: 作者提出相位相干双色场驱动的反演偶三阶直流响应，结合中心对称磁点群与共线反铁磁自旋点群的系统性对称性分析，并在反演堆垛双层2H-MoS2及中心对称共线交错磁体中进行计算验证。
AI.result: 研究表明双色场的偏振方向和相对相位可直接控制电流方向，并可隔离电荷电流为零而自旋电流有限的纯自旋通道；相对光学相位还决定响应大小与符号。计算显示两类互补体系（强与弱自旋轨道耦合）均具有共振增强、相位可调的自旋光电流。
AI.conclusion: 相干双色光的偏振方向与相对相位可作为中心对称材料中自旋输运的主动控制参数，为无需打破反演对称性的自旋光电流产生与调控提供方案。

title: A GPU-Native Nested Sampling Framework for Finite-Temperature Materials Modelling with Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials
summary: Modern equivariant machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have dramatically improved the accuracy of and the scales accessible to atomistic simulation, yet the thermodynamic sampling methods needed to turn those potentials into finite-temperature phase stability predictions have not kept pace computationally. We present the GPU-native, massively parallel nested sampling framework JAXRENS, implemented on top of JAX, which removes the practical bottlenecks preventing atomistic nested sampling from being combined with state-of-the-art MLIPs. The framework provides distributed multi-GPU execution, vectorised ensembles of walkers, and direct interoperability with modern force fields. We demonstrate the highly beneficial scaling of JAXRENS on hardware accelerators, and apply it to the simulation of the ZnS phase diagram based on a MACE foundation model, a procedure previously computationally inaccessible. Despite requiring in the order of 10^10 model evaluations, the final converged simulation completed within six days on four GPUs, marking an important step towards routine, first-principles-quality predictions of finite-temperature phase stability using machine-learned interatomic potentials.

AI.tldr: JAXRENS 是一个基于 JAX 的 GPU 原生、大规模并行嵌套采样框架，可将现代机器学习原子间势用于有限温度相稳定性预测，并在 ZnS 相图模拟中显著加速。
AI.motivation: 等变 MLIP 已大幅提升原子模拟的精度与可扩展规模，但用于有限温度相稳定性预测的热力学采样方法在计算上未同步发展，实际瓶颈阻碍了原子尺度嵌套采样与先进 MLIP 的结合。
AI.method: 作者提出 JAXRENS，基于 JAX 实现 GPU 原生、大规模并行嵌套采样，支持分布式多 GPU 执行、向量化 walker 集合以及与现代力场直接互操作。
AI.result: JAXRENS 在硬件加速器上表现出良好扩展性；使用 MACE 基础模型模拟 ZnS 相图，尽管约需 10^10 次模型评估，最终收敛模拟在 4 块 GPU 上 6 天内完成，而此前计算上不可行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作移除了原子尺度嵌套采样与先进 MLIP 结合的实际瓶颈，是迈向利用 MLIP 进行常规、第一性原理质量有限温度相稳定性预测的重要一步。

title: Uncovering the Structural, Electronic, and Electrostatic Landscapes of SrTiO$_3$ Grain Boundaries via Grand Canonical Monte Carlo with a Machine-Learning Interatomic Potential
summary: Grain boundaries in perovskites exhibit a rich variety of electronic, polar and magnetic properties, yet identifying their atomic structures and compositions remains challenging. Here, we combine the Grand Canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC) method with a universal machine-learning interatomic potential to explore the coupled compositional and structural phase space of $\Sigma$5(310)[001] SrTiO$_3$ grain boundaries. The resulting chemical potential phase diagram identifies ten stable structures belonging to four motif families: large Sr kite, small Sr kite, incomplete Sr large kite, and Ti-rich structures. Extending the GCMC method to the Sigma5(210)[001] and Sigma17(410)[001] grain boundaries reveals how grain boundary plane and inclination angle influence the competition between small- and large-kite motifs. Density functional theory calculations of the predicted Sigma5(310)[001] grain boundaries show that the composition and atomic structure strongly govern the spatial distribution of conduction and valence band edge states, interfacial band alignment, and carrier localization. Four distinct electronic regimes emerge: localized electron-doped, delocalized electron-doped, insulating, and hole-attracting states. Our electrostatics analysis reveals the coexistence of the short-range electric fields at the reconstructed GB core associated with local atomic density and bonding, and the longer-range fields outside the core arising from the space charge. These fields can also couple to local polar distortions and generate composition-dependent polarization patterns. These results establish an efficient framework for exploring oxide perovskite grain boundary structures and reveal how stoichiometry and atomic reconstruction couple to electronic structure, electrostatics, and local polarization, providing a route toward predictive grain boundary engineering in functional perovskites.

AI.tldr: 该文将巨正则蒙特卡洛（GCMC）与通用机器学习原子间势结合，系统探索SrTiO3晶界的成分—结构相空间，并用DFT揭示晶界原子重构对电子结构、静电和极化的调控。
AI.motivation: 钙钛矿晶界具有丰富的电子、极性和磁性质，但其原子结构与成分的确定仍很困难，亟需高效且可预测的晶界结构探索框架。
AI.method: 针对Σ5(310)[001] SrTiO3晶界，采用GCMC结合通用机器学习原子间势构建化学势相图；并将方法扩展至Σ5(210)[001]和Σ17(410)[001]晶界；对预测的Σ5(310)[001]结构进行DFT计算和静电分析。
AI.result: 化学势相图识别出10种稳定结构，归为四类motif家族：大Sr kite、小Sr kite、不完整Sr大kite和Ti-rich结构；晶界面和倾角影响小/大kite motif竞争。DFT表明成分和原子结构强烈调控导带/价带边态空间分布、界面能带对齐和载流子局域化，出现四种电子 regime：局域电子掺杂、离域电子掺杂、绝缘和吸引空穴态。静电分析揭示重构晶界核心处由局域原子密度和成键引起的短程电场，以及核心外由空间电荷引起的长程电场；这些场可与局域极性畸变耦合，产生成分依赖的极化图案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了探索氧化物钙钛矿晶界结构的高效框架，揭示化学计量比和原子重构如何耦合电子结构、静电与局域极化，为功能钙钛矿的预测性晶界工程提供路径。

title: Properties of [111]-oriented ferroelectric superlattices based on oxides with a perovskite structure
summary: The ground-state structures of fifteen free-standing [111]-oriented ferroelectric superlattices (SLs) based on perovskite oxides and involving a single-atom substitution---BaTiO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$, PbTiO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$, PbTiO$_3$/PbZrO$_3$, SrZrO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$, PbZrO$_3$/BaZrO$_3$, BaTiO$_3$/BaZrO$_3$, PbTiO$_3$/BaTiO$_3$, BaTiO$_3$/CaTiO$_3$, KNbO$_3$/KTaO$_3$, KNbO$_3$/NaNbO$_3$, SrTiO$_3$/SrHfO$_3$, BaTiO$_3$/BaSnO$_3$, PbTiO$_3$/CaTiO$_3$, SrTiO$_3$/CaTiO$_3$, and PbZrO$_3$/SrZrO$_3$---are calculated from first principles. It is shown that in eleven considered SLs the ground state is ferroelectric. A distinctive feature of the structure of the superlattices is that both the ferroelectric distortions and the distortions associated with octahedral rotations are described by phonons at the $\Gamma$~point of the Brillouin zone. The importance of taking into account structural distortions associated with octahedral rotations, which in some cases lead to significant changes in the ferroelectric properties of SLs, is demonstrated. The thermodynamic stability of superlattices grown in the [111] and [100] directions is compared. An analysis of the force constants of the superlattices helps to explain the peculiarities of the ferroelectric properties of the superlattices and the corresponding solid solutions.

AI.tldr: 第一性原理计算了15种[111]取向钙钛矿氧化物超晶格的基态结构，发现其中11种基态为铁电；八面体旋转对铁电性有重要影响，并通过Γ点声子和力常数解释其性质及[111]/[100]稳定性差异。
AI.motivation: 厘清[111]取向铁电超晶格中铁电畸变、八面体旋转及其热力学稳定性的作用，并解释相应超晶格与固溶体的铁电特性。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算15种自由-standing、[111]取向、含单原子取代的钙钛矿氧化物超晶格基态结构；分析Γ点声子、八面体旋转畸变和力常数，并比较[111]与[100]取向超晶格的热力学稳定性。
AI.result: 15种超晶格中11种基态为铁电；铁电畸变和八面体旋转畸变均由布里渊区Γ点声子描述；八面体旋转在某些情况下显著改变铁电性质；力常数分析可解释超晶格及对应固溶体的铁电特性。
AI.conclusion: 八面体旋转必须纳入[111]取向超晶格铁电性分析；Γ点声子与力常数可用于解释其铁电行为，并为超晶格稳定性与性能设计提供依据。

title: A Universal Diffusion Model for the Quantum Position Operator
summary: The quantum position operator and its response to perturbations underpin the functional properties of insulating materials. In the modern theory of polarization, Wannier charge centres encode Berry-phase polarization, while their structural derivatives determine key response functions. Here we introduce a universal diffusion model based on E(3)-equivariant graph neural networks for moments of the position operator, with the first moment defining Wannier centres and the second central moment their real-space localization. We demonstrate the framework for liquid water, amorphous silicon and crystalline BaTiO$_3$, and train a universal model that generalizes to 100 unseen crystals spanning a 67-species chemical space. The predicted centres reproduce infrared spectra in large liquid and amorphous cells beyond routine first-principles reach and enable finite-difference calculations of Born effective charges and piezoelectric tensors. This framework provides a scalable route to electronic polarization and localization in complex materials, supporting high-throughput screening and finite-temperature simulations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于E(3)等变图神经网络的通用扩散模型，用于预测量子位置算符的各阶矩，从而获得Wannier中心与实空间局域化，并实现复杂绝缘材料电子极化相关性质的高效计算。
AI.motivation: 量子位置算符及其对微扰的响应决定绝缘材料功能性质；现代极化理论中Wannier电荷中心编码Berry相位极化，其结构导数决定Born有效电荷、压电张量等响应函数，但复杂大体系和高通量计算仍受第一性原理成本限制。
AI.method: 构建基于E(3)等变图神经网络的通用扩散模型，学习位置算符矩：一阶矩对应Wannier中心，二阶中心矩对应其实空间局域化；在液态水、非晶硅和晶态BaTiO3上验证，并训练可泛化至67种元素组成、100种未见晶体的通用模型。
AI.result: 预测的Wannier中心可在超出常规第一性原理能力的大尺度液态和非晶胞中重现红外光谱，并支持通过有限差分计算Born有效电荷和压电张量；通用模型可泛化到100种未见晶体和67种化学元素空间。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为复杂材料中的电子极化和局域化提供可扩展计算路线，有望支持高通量筛选和有限温度模拟。

title: From dynamic strain aging to Alessandro--Beatrice--Bertotti--Montorsi dynamics of propagating Portevin--Le Chatelier bands
summary: Type-A Portevin--Le Chatelier bands are propagating strain localizations whose velocity exhibits strong intermittent fluctuations. We derive a coarse-grained connection between the dynamic-strain-aging model of H\"ahner and Rizzi and the Alessandro--Beatrice--Bertotti--Montorsi (ABBM) mean-field model of avalanche dynamics. A propagating band is reduced to a single phase coordinate while retaining the elastic feedback of the tensile machine. This feedback generates the increasing drive and restoring terms of the ABBM description. A finite-time adjoint calculation determines the stress mobility of the band and is checked independently by direct stress continuation. The mobility is approximately proportional to the hardening parameter, whereas the band speed scales approximately as its square root. Short-range heterogeneity in the plastic strain deposited by the band is converted by the global machine feedback into a Brownian effective force. The resulting reduction provides a microscopic route from dynamic strain aging to ABBM-like avalanche dynamics of propagating PLC bands.

AI.tldr: 该文将动态应变时效模型与ABBM雪崩动力学模型进行粗粒化连接，说明Type-A PLC传播带的间歇性速度波动可由机器弹性反馈下的有效雪崩动力学描述。
AI.motivation: Type-A Portevin--Le Chatelier带是传播型应变局域化，其速度具有强烈间歇波动；作者希望从微观动态应变时效机制出发，建立其与ABBM平均场雪崩动力学之间的桥接。
AI.method: 将传播带约化为单一相位坐标，同时保留拉伸机的弹性反馈；该反馈自然产生ABBM中的递增驱动项与恢复项。用有限时间伴随计算求带的应力迁移率，并用直接应力延拓独立校验；再把带沉积塑性应变中的短程非均匀性经全局机器反馈转化为Brownian有效力。
AI.result: 带的应力迁移率近似正比于硬化参数，而带速度近似按硬化参数的平方根标度；由此得到从动态应变时效到ABBM型传播PLC带雪崩动力学的约化描述。
AI.conclusion: 该约化提供了从动态应变时效微观模型通向ABBM类雪崩动力学的微观路径，并解释了传播PLC带速度间歇波动的平均场起源。

title: Machine learning interatomic potentials and orientational defects in polymers
summary: Photopolymerization of acrylated epoxidized soybean oil (AESO) is a convenient model of a self-organizing process in a soft, bio-based material: ultraviolet light starts a free-radical chain reaction, the growing network releases heat, and the mobility of molecular groups changes on several time scales at once. We follow this process from two sides. Experimentally, the real and imaginary parts of the dielectric permittivity of an AESO:VDM (1:0.5) mixture with 3 mol% of the photoinitiator DMPA were recorded at 500-5000 Hz under an intermittent on/off illumination protocol, and the resulting time series were analysed with a sliding-window Shannon entropy and the Grassberger-Procaccia correlation integral. Both measures show that short light pulses at the start of curing trigger strongly correlated, collective relaxation, which fades as the network forms, leaving only localized reorientations active. We describe these reorientations as orientational defects and quantify their energetics with the MACE-OFF23 machine learning interatomic potential, using relaxed dihedral scans of five rotational modes ($\alpha$, $\alpha/\beta$, $\beta$, $\gamma$, $\delta$) of an AESO fragment. Compared with density functional theory (DFT) reference profiles, MACE reproduces the shape of all five profiles (Pearson $r=0.95$-$0.98$) and the hierarchy of barriers - from 2.9 eV for the constrained main-chain rotation, through 0.54-0.81 eV for the acrylate rotations, to 0.16-0.18 eV for the methyl and 0.06 eV for the hydroxyl rotation - while underestimating the barrier heights by 3-20%. A simple Arrhenius estimate shows that the acrylate rotations are the modes closest to the frequency window of the dielectric measurement.

AI.tldr: 该研究结合介电弛豫实验与MACE-OFF23机器学习势，揭示AESO光聚合网络中短紫外脉冲触发的集体弛豫及其向局部取向缺陷弛豫的转变。
AI.motivation: AESO光聚合是软质生物基材料自组织过程的便利模型：UV引发自由基链反应、网络放热且分子基团迁移性在多时间尺度变化；作者希望从宏观介电响应与分子取向缺陷两个层面理解该过程。
AI.method: 实验上，对含3 mol% DMPA的AESO:VDM（1:0.5）混合物在500–5000 Hz、间歇开/关光照下记录介电常数实部与虚部时间序列，并用滑动窗口Shannon熵和Grassberger-Procaccia关联积分分析；模拟上用MACE-OFF23机器学习原子间势对AESO片段的五个旋转模式（α、α/β、β、γ、δ）进行弛豫二面角扫描，并与DFT参考势能剖面比较。
AI.result: 两种时间序列度量均显示，固化初期的短光脉冲触发强相关、集体性弛豫，随后随网络形成而衰减，仅保留局部重取向；这些重取向被描述为取向缺陷。MACE重现了五个DFT剖面的形状（Pearson r=0.95–0.98）和势垒层级：主链受限旋转约2.9 eV、丙烯酸酯旋转0.54–0.81 eV、甲基旋转0.16–0.18 eV、羟基旋转约0.06 eV，但势垒高度低估3–20%；简单Arrhenius估计表明丙烯酸酯旋转最接近介电测量的频率窗口。
AI.conclusion: 短光脉冲在固化早期诱导的集体弛豫会随网络交联而局域化，取向缺陷是理解AESO网络弛豫的关键；MACE-OFF23能以较低成本较好再现DFT势垒层级，并指出丙烯酸酯旋转是与实验介电频率窗口最相关的分子模式。

title: Large Single Crystal Growth and Transport Properties of KCd$_4$As$_3$ and RbCd$_4$As$_3$
summary: Large-size KCd$_4$As$_3$ and RbCd$_4$As$_3$ single crystals were grown using the flux method. Appropriate flux for growing single crystals was determined to be Cd$_2$As, resulting in the increase in their size to be a centimeter for KCd$_4$As$_3$. The KCd$_4$As$_3$ and RbCd$_4$As$_3$ crystals exhibited metal-like temperature dependences of their electrical resistivities with negative Seebeck coefficients, characterizing them as n-type thermoelectric materials.

AI.tldr: 采用Cd2As助熔剂法生长出大尺寸KCd4As3和RbCd4As3单晶，并确认二者为n型热电材料。
AI.motivation: 获得大尺寸单晶以研究KCd4As3和RbCd4As3的电输运与热电性能。
AI.method: 使用助熔剂法生长单晶，并确定Cd2As为合适助熔剂。
AI.result: KCd4As3单晶尺寸可增大至厘米级；两种晶体的电阻率呈金属性温度依赖，Seebeck系数为负。
AI.conclusion: Cd2As适合生长该类单晶，KCd4As3和RbCd4As3表现为n型热电材料。

title: Structure and Thermal Conductivity of Epoxy-Graphene Oxide Composites from 4.5 to 300 K
summary: The microscopic mechanisms of heat transport in structurally disordered polymer-carbon composites remain incompletely understood, particularly over the broad temperature range extending from cryogenic to ambient conditions. Here, we investigate the relationship between structural organization and thermal transport in epoxy-graphene oxide (GO) composites with nominal GO contents of 0.25-10 wt.% relative to the resin (0.21-6.1 wt.% of the total composite mass). X-ray diffraction reveals predominantly amorphous scattering without a detectable GO(001) reflection, suggesting substantial suppression of ordered GO stacking within the cured epoxy matrix. Raman spectroscopy confirms the increasing contribution of the carbon phase while revealing no pronounced changes in the characteristic vibrational bands of the epoxy network. Thermal-conductivity measurements (4.5-300 K) demonstrate that GO incorporation modifies the temperature dependence of heat transport rather than producing a simple conductivity enhancement. The experimental data are described by a phenomenological multichannel model comprising a temperature-independent plateau term and two or three effective Arrhenius-type contributions characterized by distinct temperature scales ranging from a few to several hundred kelvin. The low-temperature conductivity plateau observed at lower GO concentrations is no longer resolved in GO-6 and GO-10, indicating a qualitative change in the temperature dependence of heat transport. These results establish a correlation between structural organization and the redistribution of effective thermal-transport contributions in epoxy-GO composites, providing an experimental basis for further microscopic interpretation within the framework of unified vibrational thermal-transport theory.

AI.tldr: 研究了环氧-氧化石墨烯（GO）复合材料从4.5 K到300 K的热输运，发现GO主要改变热导率的温度依赖关系而非简单提高热导率，并与GO片层有序堆叠受抑制及有效热输运通道重分布相关。
AI.motivation: 结构无序的聚合物-碳复合材料中热输运的微观机制尚不清楚，尤其缺乏从低温到室温宽温区内结构组织与热输运关系的实验认识。
AI.method: 制备GO标称含量0.25–10 wt.%（占树脂；占总复合材料0.21–6.1 wt.%）的环氧-GO复合材料；用X射线衍射和拉曼光谱表征结构；在4.5–300 K测量热导率；用包含温度无关平台项及2–3个不同温标Arrhenius型贡献的现象学多通道模型描述数据。
AI.result: XRD以非晶散射为主且无可检测GO(001)反射，表明固化环氧中GO有序堆叠被显著抑制；拉曼显示碳相贡献增强但环氧特征振动带无明显变化。GO引入改变热输运温度依赖而非产生简单热导率增强；低GO含量下的低温热导平台在GO-6和GO-10中不再可分辨，显示热输运温度依赖发生定性变化；多通道模型可描述实验数据。
AI.conclusion: 环氧-GO复合材料中结构组织与有效热输运贡献的重分布相关，为在统一振动热输运理论框架下进一步微观解释提供实验基础。

title: Compositional Mapping of Martensitic and Magnetic Transitions in Ni-Fe-Ga Bulk Alloys and Microwires
summary: Despite extensive research on Ni-Fe-Ga magnetic shape-memory alloys, the compositional dependence of their martensitic and magnetic transition temperatures remains unclear. We analyze published bulk-alloy data alongside two complementary microwire series. While the pooled data show no unique dependence on e/a, elemental-concentration analysis reveals that Ni and Fe are the primary compositional controls of M_s and T_c, respectively, within 26-28 at.% Ga: M_s = 43.6 c_Ni - 2079 K and T_c = 17.4 c_Fe - 30 K. At fixed Ga, this creates a trade-off: raising M_s generally lowers T_c and vice versa, making it difficult to keep both above room temperature. Around 25 at.% Ga, bulk data exhibit considerable scatter, partly attributable to gamma-phase formation. Glass-coated microwires produced by the Taylor-Ulitovsky method, in which the gamma phase has generally not been reported, extend the accessible composition range toward lower Ga contents. The Ni(73-x)Fe(x)Ga27 (x = 18-22) series and the Ga-rich Ni50Fe21Ga29 and Ni50Fe23Ga27 microwires broadly follow the corresponding bulk trends. Remarkably, Ni50Fe25Ga25 and Ni50Fe27Ga23 microwires depart sharply from these trends, combining M_s at or above room temperature with T_c > 395 K. Their functional potential is demonstrated by approximately 10% reversible strain in Ni50Fe27Ga23 microwire during thermal cycling under constant tensile stresses up to 200 MPa.

AI.tldr: 该文通过汇总已发表的Ni-Fe-Ga块体数据并分析两类微丝系列，澄清了马氏体转变温度M_s与居里温度T_c的成分控制规律，并发现低Ga微丝可同时实现室温以上M_s和高于395 K的T_c，展示出约10%的可逆应变。
AI.motivation: Ni-Fe-Ga磁性形状记忆合金虽研究广泛，但其马氏体转变温度和磁性转变温度随成分的变化规律仍不明确，尤其难以在固定Ga含量下同时将M_s和T_c保持在室温以上。
AI.method: 将已发表块体合金数据与两类微丝数据联合分析；用电子浓度e/a和元素浓度分别考察成分依赖性；采用Taylor-Ulitovsky法制备玻璃包覆微丝，研究Ni(73-x)Fe(x)Ga27（x=18-22）及Ga富集Ni50Fe21Ga29、Ni50Fe23Ga27、Ni50Fe25Ga25、Ni50Fe27Ga23等成分，并在恒定拉伸应力下进行热循环测试。
AI.result: 汇总数据对e/a无唯一依赖；在26-28 at.% Ga范围内，Ni主要控制M_s（M_s=43.6c_Ni-2079 K），Fe主要控制T_c（T_c=17.4c_Fe-30 K），固定Ga时提高M_s通常降低T_c。约25 at.% Ga块体数据分散，部分归因于gamma相形成；微丝中gamma相通常未报道，可扩展至更低Ga含量。Ni(73-x)Fe(x)Ga27及Ga富集微丝大体遵循块体趋势，但Ni50Fe25Ga25和Ni50Fe27Ga23显著偏离，兼具室温以上M_s和T_c>395 K；Ni50Fe27Ga23微丝在最高200 MPa恒定拉伸应力热循环下实现约10%可逆应变。
AI.conclusion: Ni-Fe-Ga体系中M_s和T_c分别主要由Ni和Fe浓度调控，固定Ga时存在M_s与T_c的权衡；Taylor-Ulitovsky玻璃包覆微丝可拓展低Ga成分空间并抑制gamma相，特定低Ga成分可同时获得高M_s和高T_c，并表现出显著的可逆应变功能潜力。

title: Machine-learned potentials for iron oxides at extreme conditions
summary: Reliable phase stability requires accurate relative free energies, which small force errors alone do not guarantee. We develop atomic-cluster-expansion potentials for five iron oxides from Fe$_2$O to Fe$_2$O$_3$, covering crystalline and liquid states at 140--260\,GPa and 1000--11000\,K, with electronic and ionic temperatures matched. Force-dominated training leaves systematic energy offsets between structure families of up to 41\,meV/atom that persist despite additional training data. Stronger energy weighting and weaker regularization largely remove these offsets, while converged k-point sampling prevents further composition-dependent biases. The final potentials achieve held-out energy errors of 2.0--5.5\,meV/atom and first-order free-energy errors within 3.4\,meV/atom for liquids at 5000--9000\,K. However, an untrained NiAs-type FeO phase exhibits a free-energy error of 57\,meV/atom despite a low extrapolation grade. These results show that reliable phase-diagram calculations require control of relative energy offsets and explicit free-energy validation of every competing phase.

AI.tldr: 该文指出仅靠小力误差不足以保证相稳定性，需控制相对自由能误差；作者开发了五种铁氧化物的原子团簇展开势并系统评估其自由能精度。
AI.motivation: 可靠相图计算依赖准确的相对自由能，而仅降低力误差并不能保证结构家族间能量偏移足够小，因此需要针对相对能量和自由能进行验证。
AI.method: 针对Fe2O到Fe2O3五种铁氧化物，在140–260 GPa、1000–11000 K且电子/离子温度匹配条件下构建原子团簇展开势，覆盖晶态与液态；比较力主导训练、增强能量权重、减弱正则化及收敛k点采样对系统性能量偏移和组分相关偏差的影响。
AI.result: 力主导训练会在结构家族间留下最高41 meV/atom的系统能量偏移且增加数据仍存在；增强能量权重并减弱正则化可基本消除偏移，收敛k点采样可防止组分相关偏差。最终势的留出能量误差为2.0–5.5 meV/atom，5000–9000 K液态一阶自由能误差在3.4 meV/atom以内；但未训练的NiAs型FeO相自由能误差达57 meV/atom，尽管外推等级较低。
AI.conclusion: 可靠相图计算必须控制结构家族间相对能量偏移，并对每一个竞争相进行显式自由能验证，而不能仅依赖力误差或外推指标。

title: Orientation-Tunable Interfacial Thermal Conductance in Lateral MoSe2/MoS2 Heterostructures: A Deep Potential Molecular Dynamics Study
summary: Managing heat flow across interfaces in lateral 2D transition-metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterostructures is a key challenge for next-generation nanoelectronic and optoelectronic devices. To tackle this, we trained a deep learning interatomic potential (DLP) using DeePMD-kit on density functional theory (DFT) data, then paired it with non-equilibrium molecular dynamics (NEMD) simulations to study interfacial thermal conductance (ITC) in lateral MoSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructures, considering both armchair and zigzag interface orientations. The potential we trained closely matches DFT energies, forces, and phonon dispersion relations, which confirms its reliability for thermal transport simulations. Examining cell lengths from 10 to 40 nm and extrapolating to infinite length, the armchair interface shows a higher ITC (473 MW/m$^2$K) than the zigzag interface (387 MW/m$^2$K), and the armchair interface remains higher at every length considered. Both increase further as temperature rises. At 300 K, the vibrational density of states shows greater phonon spectral overlap at the armchair interface than at the zigzag interface. Together, these results offer a solid machine-learning framework for studying heat transport in lateral TMD heterostructures, and identify interface orientation as an effective means of controlling heat dissipation at these junctions.

AI.tldr: 该文用DFT训练的深度学习势结合NEMD，研究横向MoSe2/MoS2异质结界面热导，发现扶手椅界面热导高于锯齿界面，且界面取向可调控散热。
AI.motivation: 横向2D TMD异质结界面的热流管理是下一代纳米电子和光电子器件的关键挑战，需要理解并控制界面热导。
AI.method: 基于DFT数据用DeePMD-kit训练深度学习原子间势，并用NEMD模拟横向MoSe2/MoS2异质结的界面热导，考虑扶手椅和锯齿界面取向，计算10–40 nm胞长并外推至无限长，同时验证能量、力和声子色散。
AI.result: 外推无限长时扶手椅界面ITC为473 MW/m2K，高于锯齿界面的387 MW/m2K，且在各长度下均更高；温度升高时两者ITC均增加；300 K下扶手椅界面的声子谱重叠更大。
AI.conclusion: 该机器学习框架可用于研究横向TMD异质结热输运，界面取向是控制此类结散热的重要有效手段。

title: The Long and Winding Pore: Tuning Porosity in Templated Nanoporous Carbons
summary: Disordered materials pose a recurring challenge for molecular simulation: realistic structural models are often generated through thermal protocols in which several structural descriptors emerge simultaneously and cannot easily be varied independently. Nanoporous carbons constitute a particularly relevant example: pore size, wall order, curvature, and network tortuosity generally emerge as outcomes of the thermal preparation protocol, rather than being independently prescribed structural parameters. Moreover, for practical applications, models of porous materials should ideally exhibit a percolating pore network, capable of supporting end-to-end transport of adsorbed species through the material. To this end, here we introduce a hierarchy of templating strategies, built around a common melt-quench-anneal protocol driven by a machine-learned interatomic potential for carbon, that progressively separates these variables. A rigid cylindrical template interacting with the environment through a tunable Lennard-Jones potential provides independent control over pore size and local wall organization, while leaving the structural disorder of the surrounding carbon matrix essentially unchanged. Generalizing the template to a spring-connected, tortuous backbone further allows pore geometry and curvature to be prescribed without qualitatively altering the local templating mechanism established for the straight pore. Finally, making the template mobile lets the growing carbon network reshape it in turn, which sharpens pore boundaries and allows sub-nanometer pore sizes to be targeted precisely, as needed for applications such as supercapacitor electrodes. Ultimately, this approach enables systematic studies of structure-property relationships in porous materials for applications such as energy storage, desalination and gas capture.

AI.tldr: 该文提出基于机器学习原子间势的熔融-淬火-退火协议与分级模板策略，用于在纳米多孔碳模型中逐步解耦孔尺寸、孔壁有序度、曲率和网络迂曲度等结构描述符，并实现可渗透孔网络与亚纳米孔的可控制备。
AI.motivation: 无序材料模拟中多个结构描述符常由热制备协议同时涌现且难以独立调控；纳米多孔碳的孔径、孔壁有序性、曲率和迂曲度通常不是独立预设参数。实际应用还要求模型具有贯穿的孔网络以支持吸附物种的端到端输运。
AI.method: 构建围绕统一熔融-淬火-退火流程的分级模板策略，并由机器学习原子间势驱动碳结构生成：先用可调Lennard-Jones相互作用的刚性圆柱模板独立控制孔径与局部孔壁组织；再将模板推广为弹簧连接的迂曲骨架以预设孔几何与曲率；最后使模板可移动，让生长的碳网络反过来重塑模板。
AI.result: 刚性圆柱模板可在基本不改变周围碳基体结构无序度的前提下调控孔径和局部孔壁组织；弹簧连接迂曲骨架可在不改变直孔局部模板机制的情况下预设孔几何与曲率；可移动模板可锐化孔边界并精确靶向亚纳米孔径。
AI.conclusion: 该分级模板方法能够系统研究多孔材料的结构-性能关系，并服务于储能、海水淡化和气体捕集等应用。

title: Atomic-scale assembly of sulfur vacancy complexes for tailored in-gap states in monolayer WS$_{2}$
summary: Atomic-scale defects in two-dimensional semiconductors are quasi-isolated quantum systems with promise for emerging technologies. Although their potential as spin qubits, quantum sensors and single-photon emitters has been demonstrated experimentally, creating them deterministically and identifying them chemically remains challenging, which limits control over their electronic states. In this work we assemble sulfur vacancies in monolayer WS$_{2}$ into complexes of different sizes and geometries using the tip of a scanning tunneling microscope. We study their electronic properties by a combination of scanning tunneling spectroscopy and density functional theory, revealing the intricate influences of geometry, underlying point group symmetries and spin-orbit coupling on hybridized states. Among the realized sulfur vacancy complexes, we characterize two configurations that are candidates for bright single photon emitters. Our findings demonstrate an atomic-scale method for engineering quantum states within the band gap of two-dimensional semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 利用扫描隧道显微镜针尖在单层WS2中确定性组装硫空位复合体，并结合STS与DFT研究其杂化电子态及单光子发射候选构型。
AI.motivation: 二维半导体中的原子级缺陷是有望用于自旋量子比特、量子传感器和单光子发射器的准孤立量子体系，但其确定性制备与化学识别仍困难，限制了对电子态的控制。
AI.method: 用扫描隧道显微镜针尖将单层WS2中的硫空位组装成不同尺寸和几何构型的复合体；采用扫描隧道谱与密度泛函理论相结合研究其电子性质。
AI.result: 揭示了复合体几何构型、所属点群对称性及自旋轨道耦合对杂化态的复杂影响，并在已实现的硫空位复合体中表征出两种亮单光子发射器候选构型。
AI.conclusion: 研究展示了一种在二维半导体带隙内原子级工程化量子态的方法，为确定性构建和调控缺陷量子态提供了途径。

title: Grain-size distribution characterization from single-shot x-ray diffraction using hierarchical Bayesian multi-emitter analysis
summary:
The distribution of grain sizes in a polycrystalline material can be determined from a 2D x-ray diffraction pattern by counting and characterizing diffraction spots, so long as the spots are discrete. This approach breaks down if there is substantial overlap of the reflections due to either a large number of grains in the scattering volume or crowding of spots caused by crystallographic texture. As a result, the spot-counting approach to grain size determination is infeasible for many situations of practical interest.
  We address this limitation by applying hierarchical probabilistic learning using a reversible-jump Markov chain Monte Carlo framework to jointly infer diffraction spot populations and their intensity distributions. Using synthetic diffraction patterns, we show how this hierarchical model allows recovery of diffraction peak intensities across a wide variety of grain-size distributions and crystallographic textures. From the recovered peak intensities we infer grain-size distributions themselves and characterize the regimes of grain size and texture for which this approach is practical. Finally, we demonstrate the application of our technique by comparing grain-size distributions in Cu-Ti alloy specimens obtained from 2D x-ray diffraction patterns with those from electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD). This method of grain-size distribution determination is expected to be particularly useful in the context of high-throughput experimentation, where the minimal sample preparation requirements and short exposure times of single-shot x-ray diffraction are substantial advantages relative to microscopy techniques.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于可逆跳跃马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（RJMCMC）的分层概率学习框架，用于从二维X射线衍射图样中联合推断衍射斑点群及其强度分布，从而在斑点重叠情况下仍能估计晶粒尺寸分布。
AI.motivation: 传统通过计数和表征离散衍射斑点来确定晶粒尺寸分布的方法，在散射体积内晶粒数过多或晶体织构导致斑点拥挤、反射显著重叠时失效，因此难以用于许多实际场景。
AI.method: 采用分层概率学习与可逆跳跃马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛框架，联合推断衍射斑点群和峰强度分布；利用合成衍射图样验证峰强度恢复与晶粒尺寸分布推断，并刻画该方法适用的晶粒尺寸与织构范围；最后将Cu-Ti合金样品的二维X射线衍射结果与电子背散射衍射（EBSD）得到的晶粒尺寸分布进行比较。
