AI.result: 合成数据表明，该分层模型可在多种晶粒尺寸分布和晶体织构下恢复衍射峰强度，并由恢复的峰强度推断晶粒尺寸分布；同时明确了方法可行的晶粒尺寸与织构区间，并在Cu-Ti合金中实现了与EBSD结果的对比验证。
AI.conclusion: 该晶粒尺寸分布测定方法可克服衍射斑点重叠导致的传统计数法失效问题，尤其适合高通量实验，因为单次X射线衍射具有样品制备要求低和曝光时间短等相对显微技术的显著优势。

title: Characterizing adsorption thermodynamics in carbon capture materials: an efficient first-principles approach
summary: Porous materials offer a vast design space for CO$_2$ capture, whose exploration hinges on efficient and accurate first-principles predictions of the thermodynamics governing adsorption. However, simulating isotherms and heats of adsorption using grand canonical molecular simulations is extremely computationally expensive when combined with accurate ab initio treatments of the molecular interactions, limiting screening to low-pressure uptake encoded in the Henry constant. Identifying and designing the best CO$_2$ capture materials requires a strategy that can efficiently calculate their adsorption properties using ab initio potential energy surfaces such as those now available from foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Here we develop a neural classical density functional (cDFT) framework for carbon capture processes that allows direct calculation of adsorption isotherms from low to high loading limits of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) without grand canonical simulations. We demonstrate the success of our approach by calculating the ab initio adsorption isotherms for over 5,000 experimentally reported MOFs. From our screening, we show how these materials can be characterized using four isotherm shapes, arising from their pore size and binding sites, which the Henry constant cannot distinguish. We show that these shapes, rather than the binding strength alone, decide which MOFs suit which process: small pores with strong binding sites for vacuum and temperature swings at low pressure, large pores with weakly binding walls for pressure swings. Finally, we identify the most promising candidates by weighing their working capacity against the energy needed for regeneration.

AI.tldr: 提出神经经典密度泛函（neural cDFT）框架，可直接从低到高负载计算MOF的CO2吸附等温线，避免昂贵的巨正则模拟；对5000余种实验MOF进行从头算筛选，发现等温线形状而非仅结合强度决定材料适用工艺，并权衡工作容量与再生能耗选出候选材料。
AI.motivation: 多孔材料CO2捕集设计空间巨大，但结合从头算相互作用的巨正则分子模拟计算等温线和吸附热极其昂贵，现有筛选多局限于Henry常数所反映的低压吸附。需高效利用MLIP等从头算势能面预测吸附热力学。
AI.method: 开发用于碳捕集过程的神经经典密度泛函框架，从低到高负载直接计算金属有机框架（MOF）吸附等温线，无需巨正则模拟；基于MLIP等从头算势能面计算5000余种实验报道MOF的吸附等温线并进行筛选。
AI.result: 获得5000余种MOF的从头算吸附等温线，并按孔尺寸和结合位点归纳为四种等温线形状，这些形状无法由Henry常数区分。结果表明：小孔且强结合位点适合低压真空/变温摇摆；大孔且弱结合壁适合变压摇摆。进一步以工作容量与再生能耗的权衡识别最有前景候选材料。
AI.conclusion: 神经cDFT可实现高效、准确的MOF吸附等温线从头算筛选；等温线形状是连接孔结构、结合位点与CO2捕集工艺适用性的关键描述符，仅凭结合强度或Henry常数不足以指导材料设计，需综合工作容量和再生能耗评估候选材料。

authors: Luka H. Mikek (Materials Science & Engineering Department
Dallas R. Trinkle (Materials Science & Engineering Department
title: Prediction and Screening of $\eta$-carbide-type Nitrides for Ammonia Synthesis
summary: Synthesis of ammonia is of critical importance to applications in energy, industrial chemistry, and especially agriculture, and is accomplished industrially using the carbon- and energy-intensive Haber-Bosch process. {\eta}-carbide-type nitrides such as Co3Mo3N have gained attention in recent years as alternative ammonia synthesis catalysts with the potential to lower these energy demands. Co3Mo3N is experimentally observed to undergo a reversible phase transition from Co3Mo3N to Co6Mo6N, offering a chemical looping-based NH3 synthesis route that has not been fully explored. In this work, we present a first-principles exploration of phase change in the Co3Mo3N/Co6Mo6N system as a prototype {\eta}-carbide-type nitride and fit a cluster expansion to predict the energy of Co3Mo3Nx systems. We use our results to identify the phase energy difference as a useful screening criterion for the phase change process. We then apply this methodology to screen a broad range of {\eta}-carbide-type nitrides that combine group 4-6 transition metals with Cr, Fe, Co, Ni, or Zn. We report strong periodic trends in phase energy difference, which increases with decreasing period and group number of the group 4-6 transition metal and with distance from group 9 for the other metal. We identify Co3W3N, Fe3W3N, and several quaternary nitrides as promising candidates for NH3 synthesis via a phase change mechanism.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理与团簇展开研究η-碳化物型氮化物Co3Mo3N/Co6Mo6N的相变，并以相能量差为筛选指标寻找可用于化学链法合成NH3的候选材料。
AI.motivation: 传统Haber-Bosch合成氨过程能耗和碳排放高，而Co3Mo3N等η-碳化物型氮化物可发生可逆相变，有望通过化学链方式降低合成氨能耗，但该相变机制尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 以Co3Mo3N/Co6Mo6N为原型体系，采用第一性原理计算相变行为，拟合团簇展开预测Co3Mo3Nx体系能量，并将相能量差作为相变过程的筛选判据，进一步筛选由第4-6族过渡金属与Cr、Fe、Co、Ni或Zn组合形成的η-碳化物型氮化物。
AI.result: 发现相能量差呈现明显周期趋势：随第4-6族过渡金属的周期数和族数降低而增大，并随另一种金属远离第9族而增大；识别出Co3W3N、Fe3W3N及若干四元氮化物是有前景的NH3合成候选材料。
AI.conclusion: 相能量差可作为筛选η-碳化物型氮化物相变化学链合成氨材料的有效指标，并为Co3W3N、Fe3W3N和部分四元氮化物等候选体系提供理论依据。

title: Real-space electrostatic sums through truncation error analysis
summary: Methods that treat electrostatics in real space, without explicit reciprocal-space evaluation, are appealing for large-scale atomistic simulations. They typically employ local charge-neutralization schemes, but their relationship to the underlying error contributions of the full Ewald sum has not been fully characterized. A principled basis for parameter selection is also lacking. In this work, we show that the correction terms of Wolf's and Pickard's real-space methods approximate the truncation error of real-space electrostatic sums. This perspective motivates simplified fixed-radii and force-shifted Pickard variants that preserve the truncation-error compensation behavior while enforcing continuity of pair energy and force at the cutoff. We derive a nonempirical scaling relation for the optimal path in the parameter space of the cutoff radius and screening distance, generalizing Pickard's empirical heuristic and explaining when and why it can fail. A systematic scheme for restoring omitted reciprocal contributions is introduced, which accelerates convergence to the full Ewald energy.

AI.tldr: 该文将Wolf/Pickard实空间静电修正解释为对实空间截断误差的补偿，提出简化固定半径与力移位的Pickard变体，给出截止半径与屏蔽距离最优路径的非经验标度关系，并系统恢复被忽略的倒空间贡献以加速收敛到完整Ewald能量。
AI.motivation: 大尺度原子模拟希望避免显式倒空间计算的实空间静电方法；现有局部电荷中和方案与完整Ewald误差关系不明，参数选择缺乏原则。
AI.method: 证明Wolf和Pickard修正项近似实空间静电求和的截断误差；据此构造固定半径和力移位的Pickard变体，保持截断误差补偿且保证截断处能量与力连续；推导截止半径-屏蔽距离参数空间最优路径的标度关系，推广Pickard经验启发式并解释失效条件；提出恢复省略倒空间贡献的系统方案。
AI.result: 非经验标度关系可推广并解释Pickard启发式何时失效；新变体保持补偿行为并确保连续性；倒空间恢复方案加速收敛到完整Ewald能量。
AI.conclusion: 为实空间静电方法提供基于截断误差补偿的原理框架和参数选择依据，改善大尺度模拟中精度与效率平衡。

title: XANES-Guided Molecular Structure Generation via Conditional Diffusion and Forward Spectral Prediction
summary: Reconstructing complete molecular structures from X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) spectra remains challenging because the spectra primarily encode local chemical environments, with overlapping contributions from multiple absorbing sites. Here, we develop an inverse-forward framework combining XANES-conditioned diffusion-based molecular structure generation with forward spectral prediction for candidate selection. The inverse model generates atomic species, bond connectivity, and three-dimensional coordinates from C, N, and O K-edge XANES, given only the total atom count without molecular formulas or element-specific atom counts. Combining all three absorption edges substantially improves structural recovery, achieving a best-of-10 exact-match rate of 56.6% across 2,888 test molecules. The generated candidates also reproduce functional groups and structural motifs, achieving a macro-averaged F1 score of 0.951 across 21 categories. Ranking candidates by agreement between input and forward-predicted spectra increases the exact-match rate from 24.3% for unranked top-1 selection to 43.9%. This spectral-consistency criterion also enables atom count estimation, identifying the correct count for 65.6% of molecules among seven tested values. Application to experimental spectra yields an exact structural match for imidazole and recovers characteristic functional groups in two additional molecules, while revealing limitations due to simulation-experiment spectral discrepancies. These findings establish an inverse-forward approach for reconstructing whole-molecule structures from complementary element-specific XANES information.

AI.tldr: 提出XANES反演-正向筛选框架，可从C/N/O K边XANES重建分子结构，并通过正向谱预测重排候选。
AI.motivation: XANES主要编码局域化学环境且多吸收位点信号重叠，直接从XANES重建完整分子结构仍具挑战。
AI.method: 构建XANES条件扩散生成模型，仅凭总原子数生成原子种类、键连接和三维坐标；再用正向谱预测对候选进行谱一致性排序与选择。
AI.result: 联合C/N/O三边显著提升重建，2,888个测试分子best-of-10精确匹配率56.6%；21类官能团/结构基序宏平均F1为0.951；谱一致性排序将top-1精确匹配率从24.3%提升至43.9%，并在7个候选值中以65.6%正确估计原子数；实验谱中咪唑实现精确结构匹配，另两分子恢复特征官能团。
AI.conclusion: 该逆-正框架利用互补的元素特异性XANES信息实现全分子结构重建，但受模拟-实验谱差异限制。

title: Reconciling Models for Infinite-Layer Nickelate Superconductors: Role of Interstitial-$s$ Band or $A$-Pocket
summary: Understanding the minimal model that captures the essential physics of infinite-layer nickelate superconductors remains a central challenge. Using first-principles density-functional theory combined with dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT), we compute and compare the strongly correlated electronic structures and optical spectra of various effective models for the infinite-layer nickelate LaNiO$_2$, ranging from a $d_{x^2-y^2}$ 1-band model to a full 6-band model with all Ni-$3d$ plus an interstitial-$s$ orbital. The results demonstrate that Ni-$3d$ 5-band models overestimate the Hundness picture, whereas 6-band models, which explicitly include the interstitial-$s$ band and have an $A$-pocket, recover the characteristic Mottness physics. Importantly, the influence of the interstitial-$s$ band on the correlations of the $d_{x^2-y^2}$ band is negligible. Thus, superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelates can be reliably described within a single-band Hubbard framework, while the accurate description of inter-orbital properties such as (optical) conductivities requires the inclusion of at least the interstitial-$s$ band.

AI.tldr: 该文用DFT+DMFT比较LaNiO$_2$不同有效模型，指出超导可由单带Hubbard模型描述，但光学等轨道间性质需至少引入间隙s带。
AI.motivation: 无限层镍酸盐超导体的最小有效模型仍不明确，需厘清Ni-3d多带与间隙s带在强关联物理中的作用。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论结合动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT），计算并比较从d$_{x^2-y^2}$单带到包含全部Ni-3d及间隙s轨道的六带模型等不同有效模型的强关联电子结构与光学谱。
AI.result: Ni-3d五带模型高估Hundness；显式包含间隙s带并具有A-pocket的六带模型恢复Mottness物理；间隙s带对d$_{x^2-y^2}$带关联影响可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 无限层镍酸盐超导性可在单带Hubbard框架内可靠描述，而准确描述轨道间性质如（光）电导率至少需包含间隙s带。

title: Hidden topological signatures in a van der Waals ferromagnet revealed by spin-resolved circular-dichroic photoemission
summary: Layered ferromagnets with strongly correlated electrons provide a platform for exploring the interplay among magnetism, spin-orbit coupling, and nontrivial band topology. $\mathrm{Ni}_{1/4}\mathrm{TaSe}_2$ is a correlated van der Waals ferromagnet with a transition temperature of 58 K that lies close in composition to a superconducting phase that emerges upon Ni depletion. Here, we combine spin- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, circular-dichroism measurements, and density functional theory calculations to investigate its spin-resolved electronic structure. We observe spin-polarized states crossing the Fermi level and signatures of broken time-reversal symmetry in the ferromagnetic state. Spin-resolved circular-dichroism measurements further reveal a helicity-dependent spin response consistent with a finite spin Berry curvature and suggestive of local topological character. Together, these results establish an experimental connection between ferromagnetism, spin-polarized electronic states, and topological signatures in $\mathrm{Ni}_{1/4}\mathrm{TaSe}_2$, providing a foundation for investigating how these properties may relate to the emergence of superconductivity upon Ni depletion.

AI.tldr: 结合自旋分辨ARPES、圆二色性和DFT研究关联范德华铁磁体Ni1/4TaSe2的自旋分辨电子结构，发现自旋极化费米面态、时间反演对称性破缺迹象及与有限自旋Berry曲率一致的手性依赖自旋响应。
AI.motivation: 层状强关联铁磁体可研究磁性、自旋轨道耦合与非平庸能带拓扑的相互作用；Ni1/4TaSe2是Tc=58 K的关联范德华铁磁体，且靠近Ni耗尽后出现超导的相区，因此需厘清其自旋分辨电子结构并为理解超导涌现提供基础。
AI.method: 采用自旋分辨和角分辨光电子能谱、圆二色性测量，并结合密度泛函理论计算，研究Ni1/4TaSe2铁磁态的自旋分辨电子结构。
AI.result: 观察到跨越费米能级的自旋极化态以及铁磁态中时间反演对称性破缺的特征；自旋分辨圆二色性显示螺旋度依赖的自旋响应，与有限自旋Berry曲率一致，并暗示局域拓扑特征。
AI.conclusion: 实验建立了Ni1/4TaSe2中铁磁性、自旋极化电子态与拓扑特征之间的联系，为研究这些性质如何与Ni耗尽诱导的超导性相关联奠定了基础。

title: Nonlinear optical response with relaxation in the velocity gauge
summary: We develop a framework for the evaluation of the nonlinear optical conductivity of electrons in crystals, driven by homogeneous optical fields, taking into account dissipation effects within the relaxation time approximation (RTA). The present formalism is based on Hamiltonians with minimal light-matter coupling within the velocity gauge, where the electric field is expressed in terms of a vector potential. The nonlinear conductivities are obtained by perturbatively solving the equation of motion for the single-particle reduced density matrix, which includes dissipative effects via the relaxation time approximation. We present a perturbative method to evaluate the reference equilibrium density matrix, towards which dissipation relaxes the system, which in the velocity gauge adiabatically follows the applied vector potential, and is also broadened by dissipative effects. Comparing with previous formulations based on the length gauge, the present approach has the benefit of avoiding the cumbersome evaluation of derivatives of Bloch states with respect to momentum. We test the presented method against length-gauge results, and calculate second- and third-order responses in a graphene-like tight-binding model with a staggered sublattice potential and a periodic modulation. We find that the relaxation time approximation gives results that deviate both quantitatively and qualitatively from the simple inclusion of an imaginary damping term in the frequencies, referred to as adiabatic switching. At equal relaxation parameter, the leading above-gap injection contribution differs by a factor of two; below the gap, the numerical results indicate a finite imaginary dc response in the small-relaxation limit of the relaxation-time calculation. These results show that adiabatic switching does not generally reproduce relaxation through the equation of motion, even in the small-relaxation limit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于速度规范与弛豫时间近似（RTA）的非线性光导率计算框架，并通过石墨烯类紧束缚模型检验其与长度规范及绝热开关近似的差异。
AI.motivation: 需要一种能系统计入耗散、避免求解Bloch态对动量导数的非线性光导率方法，并澄清RTA与常用虚频阻尼（绝热开关）是否等价。
AI.method: 在速度规范下采用最小光-物质耦合，将电场表示为矢势；对单粒子约化密度矩阵运动方程进行微扰求解，并以RTA加入耗散。还提出微扰方法计算弛豫所趋向的参考平衡密度矩阵，该矩阵在速度规范下绝热跟随矢势并受耗散展宽。
AI.result: 与长度规范结果对比后，在含交错子晶格势和周期调制的石墨烯类紧束缚模型中计算二阶和三阶响应。发现RTA与绝热开关在定量和定性上均不同：相同弛豫参数下，带隙以上主导注入贡献相差两倍；带隙以下，RTA在小弛豫极限下给出有限虚部直流响应。
AI.conclusion: 绝热开关通常不能复现通过运动方程和RTA描述的弛豫效应，即使在小弛豫极限下也不等价。

title: Interface Weyl electrons in the kagome-bilayers
summary: What makes a topological character prominent is whether its characteristic electronic states are located near the Fermi energy. While the kagome-metals possess unique topological characteristics owing to their distinctive electronic band structures, i.e. flat and Dirac bands, the control of Fermi energy to accentuate these characteristics has scarcely been studied in these materials. Here, we propose a new concept for activating the topological characteristics of Weyl electrons specifically near the interface of kagome-bilayers, namely interface Weyl electrons. The kagome-bilayers prepared by a sputtering technique surprisingly exhibit atomically abrupt interfaces thanks to the suppression of interdiffusion for maintaining the crystal symmetry of the hexagonal-type D0$_{19}$ and cubic-type L1$_{2}$ structures. Much higher electrical conductivity of the kagome-bilayers compared to single-layer films indicates the emergent contribution of a highly conductive electronic state at the interfaces. The enhanced electrical conductivity and the exceptionally large anomalous Hall conductivity about 2000 $\Omega$$^{-1}$cm$^{-1}$ in the intrinsic mechanism indicates that the emergent interface electronic states comprise Weyl nodes in the D0$_{19}$ structure identified in our theoretical band calculations, triggered by nontrivial charge transfer. These results demonstrate that topological transport can be engineered at the interface of intermetallic compounds, leading further design principles towards development of device functionality.

AI.tldr: 该文提出“界面Weyl电子”概念，通过在kagome双层界面处调控费米能附近电子态来激活拓扑输运。
AI.motivation: kagome金属具有平带和Dirac带等独特能带及拓扑特性，但如何将费米能调控至其特征电子态附近、从而凸显拓扑性质仍研究不足。
AI.method: 采用溅射法制备保持六方D0_{19}与立方L1_{2}晶体对称性的kagome双层薄膜，利用界面互扩散抑制获得原子级突变界面；结合电输运测量与理论能带计算分析界面电子态和Weyl节点。
AI.result: kagome双层膜电导率显著高于单层膜，并在本征机制下表现出约2000 Ω^{-1}cm^{-1}的巨大反常霍尔电导；理论计算表明界面处由非平凡电荷转移触发D0_{19}结构中的Weyl节点，形成高导电界面Weyl电子态。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明可在金属间化合物界面工程化拓扑输运，为器件功能开发提供新的设计原则。

title: Electrostatic and Quantum Transport Engineering of Multilayer Ferroelectric Tunnel Junctions for Improved TER and RA Trade off
summary: Ferroelectric tunnel junctions (FTJs) are promising for non-volatile memory and neuromorphic computing, but achieving a high tunnel electroresistance ratio (TER) with a low resistance-area (RA) product remains challenging. In this work, TiN/Hf$_{0.5}$Zr$_{0.5}$O$_2$ (HZO)-based FTJs containing zero to three TiO$_2$ and IGZO-based quantum wells (QWs) are analyzed using the Miller ferroelectric (FE) polarization model integrated with the non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) formalism to examine the effects of QW material and thickness on polarization and transport. TiO$_2$-based structures exhibit higher polarization and TER than IGZO-based structures. At a read bias of 0.1 V, the uniform TiO$_2$ double-QW structure, with 1-nm-thick QW and insulating layer (IL) layers, gives a TER of $2.71\times10^{10}\%$ and an RA product of $5\times10^4~\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2$, compared with $5.95\times10^7\%$ and $2\times10^5~\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2$, respectively, for IGZO. Both uniform and non-uniform TiO$_2$ double-QW structures exhibit resonant tunneling (RT) and negative differential resistance (NDR) associated with QW-confined states. Increasing the first QW thickness to 1.38 nm, while keeping the second QW and both IL layers at 1 nm, shifts the confined-state energies and modifies resonant transport. The selected non-uniform structure achieves a TER of $2.95\times10^{11}\%$ and an RA product of $1.25\times10^3~\Omega\cdot\text{cm}^2$ at a read bias of 0.1 V. Elastic scattering changes the amplitude and width of QW resonant-transmission peaks, with a stronger effect on the low resistance state (LRS) than on the high resistance state (HRS). These results show that QW material and thickness optimization can improve the TER--RA trade-off, while electrode screening and elastic scattering further influence polarization-dependent transport in multilayer FTJs.

AI.tldr: 该文用Miller铁电极化模型结合NEGF形式研究TiN/HZO基铁电隧道结中TiO2与IGZO量子阱材料及厚度对极化与输运的影响，以改善高TER与低RA之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 铁电隧道结（FTJ）在非易失存储和神经形态计算中很有前景，但同时实现高隧穿电阻比（TER）和低电阻面积（RA）乘积仍具挑战。
AI.method: 构建含0至3层TiO2或IGZO量子阱（QW）的TiN/Hf0.5Zr0.5O2（HZO）基FTJ，将Miller铁电极化模型与非平衡格林函数（NEGF）结合，分析QW材料和厚度对极化及输运的影响，并考虑共振隧穿、负微分电阻和弹性散射。
AI.result: TiO2基结构比IGZO基结构具有更高极化和TER。0.1 V读偏下，均匀TiO2双QW结构（QW和绝缘层均为1 nm）给出TER=2.71×10^10%、RA=5×10^4 Ω·cm^2，而IGZO为5.95×10^7%、2×10^5 Ω·cm^2。非均匀TiO2双QW结构将第一QW厚度增至1.38 nm、第二QW和两绝缘层保持1 nm时，TER=2.95×10^11%、RA=1.25×10^3 Ω·cm^2。均匀与非均匀TiO2双QW均表现与QW限制态相关的共振隧穿和负微分电阻；弹性散射改变共振透射峰幅度和宽度，且对低阻态（LRS）影响强于高阻态（HRS）。
AI.conclusion: QW材料和厚度优化可改善TER–RA权衡；电极屏蔽与弹性散射进一步影响多层FTJ中极化依赖的输运行为。

authors: R. L. Silva. R. C. Silva
title: Conformal defects in a quasi-one-dimensional Kitaev chain: an exactly parametrized Ising defect line and a relevant vacancy
summary: The quasi-one-dimensional Kitaev chain of coupled hexagonal plaquettes recently introduced by Majumder is exactly solvable in terms of free Majorana fermions and undergoes a topological transition at the exchange anisotropy $J_x=\sqrt{2}\,J$. By eliminating the two-coordinated sites of each plaquette we reduce the zero-energy problem to a uniform Majorana chain, which yields the critical point, a single Majorana cone at $k=0$ (hence an Ising critical point with central charge $c=\tfrac12$), and closed forms for every defect quantity that follows. A weakened inter-plaquette bond $\lambda J_x$ is an exactly marginal defect with transmission $T=4\lambda^2/(1+\lambda^2)^2$ at low energy, that is, $T=\sin^2 2\phi$ with $\tan\phi=\lambda$: the bond traverses the ferromagnetic defect line of the Ising conformal field theory from the transparent point to the cut chain, and we give its exact energy dependence on the lattice. The intra-plaquette bonds land on the same line with different parametrizations: a $y$ or $z$ bond has $\tan\phi=(1+\lambda)/2$ and covers only $T\in[0.64,1]$, because the plaquette provides a parallel path, whereas an $x$ bond has $\tan\phi=(1+\lambda)/2\lambda$ and covers the strong-link half of the line, $\phi\in(\pi/4,\pi/2)$. The identification is closed by an independent observable: the coefficient of $\ln L$ in the entanglement entropy across the defect follows the conformal-field-theory function $\sigma(\sqrt T)/2$ of Brehm and Brunner to within $0.4\%$ along the whole line, with no adjustable parameter. A vacancy behaves in the opposite way. It never binds a plaquette flux, because plaquettes share no sites, but it leaves its singly bonded neighbor as a conserved classical spin whose dangling Majorana is a zero-energy resonance.

AI.tldr: 该文将 Majumder 的准一维六角 plaquette Kitaev 链在零能子空间约化为均匀 Majorana 链，确定 Jx=√2J 的 Ising 临界点，并精确刻画键缺陷与空位。
AI.motivation: 旨在解析理解该可解 Kitaev 链的拓扑相变、键缺陷的临界性质及其在纠缠熵中的普适特征。
AI.method: 消去每个 plaquette 的两个二配位格点，将零能问题化为均匀 Majorana 链；用 Ising CFT 铁磁缺陷线参数化透射率，并计算缺陷两侧熵的 ln L 系数与 Brehm-Brunner 函数比较。
AI.result: 临界点为 Jx=√2J，k=0 处单个 Majorana 锥，中心荷 c=1/2。削弱 inter-plaquette 键 λJx 是精确边缘缺陷，T=4λ²/(1+λ²)²=sin²2φ（tanφ=λ），从透明点走到切断链；y/z 内键 tanφ=(1+λ)/2，T∈[0.64,1]，x 内键 tanφ=(1+λ)/(2λ)，覆盖 φ∈(π/4,π/2)。熵的 ln L 系数在整条线上以 0.4% 内符合 σ(√T)/2，无拟合参数。空位不束缚 plaquette 磁通，但使其单键邻居成为守恒经典自旋，dangling Majorana 为零能共振。
AI.conclusion: 该链实现 Ising 临界性与精确边缘铁磁缺陷线；键缺陷可由透射率统一分类并由纠缠熵验证，而空位表现为不同机制。

title: Efficient Spectra and Dynamics with Tangent-Space Chebyshev Tree Tensor Networks
summary: We present a tangent-space Chebyshev method (TaChe), which combines tree tensor network states with Chebyshev recursion and maximum entropy spectral analysis in a tree tensor network tangent space, for quantum many-body spectra and dynamics. Implemented tensor network state calculations in the tangent space of the ground state, the core advantage of TaChe is that it can substantially reduce the computational complexity, memory usage, and numerical instability associated with tensor network state compression. Implemented on the GPU platform, it produces accurate spectra with speedups of up to $46.8$ over the previous Chebyshev tensor network method and $13.7$ over one-site time-dependent variational principle propagation in the reported benchmarks. Applications to acetonitrile, thermal aggregate emission, finite-temperature charge transport on a \(6\times6\) lattice, and internal conversion in aggregates of up to 100 molecules demonstrate the efficiency and versatility of TaChe in simulating complex molecular systems.

AI.tldr: 提出切空间Chebyshev方法TaChe，将树张量网络态、Chebyshev递推与最大熵谱分析结合于基态切空间，用于量子多体谱与动力学，并在GPU上显著加速。
AI.motivation: 传统张量网络态压缩在计算量子多体谱和动力学时存在计算复杂度高、内存占用大和数值不稳定等问题，需要更高效的谱与动力学模拟方法。
AI.method: TaChe在基态的张量网络切空间中实现Chebyshev递推和最大熵谱分析，结合树张量网络态表示，并部署于GPU平台以降低压缩相关复杂度和不稳定性。
AI.result: 在基准测试中，TaChe获得准确谱，相比先前Chebyshev张量网络方法最高加速46.8倍，相比单点含时变分原理传播加速13.7倍；并成功应用于乙腈、热聚集体发光、6×6晶格有限温度电荷输运及最多100个分子聚集体的内转换。
AI.conclusion: TaChe能显著降低张量网络态压缩的计算复杂度、内存需求和数值不稳定性，是一种高效且通用的复杂分子体系谱与动力学模拟方法。

title: Synthesis-route-dependent state selection in the frustrated spinel ZnV$_2$O$_4$
summary: The emergent properties of strongly correlated materials can be highly sensitive to how they are made, yet synthesis pathway is rarely treated as a fundamental variable governing their ground states. The spinel ZnV$_2$O$_4$ provides a model system in which to test this idea: its pyrochlore lattice of antiferromagnetically coupled V$^{3+}$ $S=1$ moments hosts competing spin and orbital degeneracies, while different synthesis routes yield markedly different low-temperature behaviour. Here, we show that changing the solid-state synthesis pathway reproducibly selects a distinct structural and magnetic ground state. Microwave-assisted solid-state synthesis (MASS) stabilises the cubic spinel structure to low temperature, suppressing the conventional cubic-to-tetragonal transition and preserving the highly frustrated $S=1$ pyrochlore lattice. Combining high-resolution diffraction, magnetometry and inelastic neutron scattering, we find a magnetic ground state exhibiting persistent spin-liquid-like dynamics together with partial spin freezing. Our results establish synthesis pathway as an experimental variable for selecting between competing emergent states in strongly correlated materials, revealing a route to accessing ground states not realised by conventional synthesis.

AI.tldr: 该文以尖晶石 ZnV2O4 为模型，证明固相合成路径可作为调控强关联材料基态的实验变量：微波辅助固相合成（MASS）稳定立方尖晶石结构并抑制立方-四方转变，从而保留高度阻挫的 V3+ S=1 烧绿石晶格，诱导出兼具持续自旋液体式动力学与部分自旋冻结的磁性基态。
AI.motivation: 强关联材料的涌现性质常对制备方式高度敏感，但合成路径很少被视为决定基态的基本变量；ZnV2O4 中竞争的自旋/轨道简并与不同合成路线导致的低温行为差异，为检验这一观点提供了模型体系。
AI.method: 采用不同固相合成路径制备 ZnV2O4，重点使用微波辅助固相合成（MASS）；结合高分辨衍射、磁测量和非弹性中子散射，表征结构转变、磁性基态与自旋动力学。
AI.result: MASS 可重复地稳定立方尖晶石结构至低温，抑制常规立方-四方结构转变，保持阻挫的 S=1 烧绿石晶格；其磁性基态表现为持续的自旋液体式动力学并伴随部分自旋冻结。
AI.conclusion: 合成路径能够选择强关联材料中相互竞争的涌现基态，并可获得常规合成未实现的基态，确立了合成路径作为研究强关联物性的实验调控变量。

title: Implementation of LDA+Gutzwiller with Newton's method
summary: In order to calculate the electronic structure of correlated materials, we propose implementation of the LDA+Gutzwiller method with Newton's method. The self-consistence process, efficiency and convergence of calculation are improved dramatically by using Newton's method with golden section search and other improvement approaches. We compare the calculated results by applying the previous linear mix method and Newton's method. We have applied our code to study the electronic structure of several typical strong correlated materials, including SrVO$_3$, LaCoO$_3$, and La$_2$O$_3$Fe$_2$Se$_2$. Our results fit quite well with the previous studies.

AI.tldr: 提出用牛顿法实现LDA+Gutzwiller方法，以更高效、稳定地计算关联材料的电子结构。
AI.motivation: 传统LDA+Gutzwiller自洽计算效率与收敛性不足，需要改进以计算关联材料电子结构。
AI.method: 采用牛顿法并结合黄金分割搜索等改进策略实现LDA+Gutzwiller自洽计算，与原有线性混合法对比，并应用于SrVO3、LaCoO3和La2O3Fe2Se2等典型强关联材料。
AI.result: 牛顿法显著提升自洽过程效率和收敛性；计算结果与已有研究吻合良好。
AI.conclusion: 基于牛顿法的LDA+Gutzwiller实现高效可靠，适用于强关联材料电子结构计算。

title: Local spin constraints and symmetry in single-$Q$ spiral magnets
summary: The Luttinger--Tisza (LT) method provides a lower bound on the energy of classical spin models but relaxes the local spin-length constraints. For a generic incommensurate single-$Q$ spiral, fixed spin length requires circular polarization on every magnetic sublattice, a condition not guaranteed by equal sublattice weights in the lowest LT eigenmode. We develop a constrained formulation for general bilinear classical spin Hamiltonians with one or two magnetic sublattices. For one sublattice, minimization reduces to a secular equation for the spiral-plane normal. For two sublattices, exact elimination of the relative phase gives a frame-independent energy on the space of two unit normals. We derive symmetry constraints by distinguishing operations that preserve or reverse the Fourier arm and those that preserve or exchange sublattices. For a model with symmetric anisotropy, numerical optimization over both spiral-plane normals yields a lower energy than either constrained pure exchange-sector state, despite the block diagonalization of the linear Hamiltonian. A separate anisotropic two-sublattice benchmark demonstrates that enforcing local circularity can shift the preferred ordering wave vector even when the lowest LT eigenmode has equal sublattice weights.

AI.tldr: 提出受约束的Luttinger-Tisza框架，修复原LT方法放松局域自旋长度约束的问题；针对单/双磁子晶格螺旋磁体给出降维优化与对称性分析，并揭示局域圆极化、各向异性和子晶格权重对能量与有序波矢的影响。
AI.motivation: LT方法虽给出经典自旋模型能量下界，但放松了局域自旋长度约束。对一般不可公度单Q螺旋，固定自旋长度要求每个磁子晶格上圆极化，而最低LT本征模中相等子晶格权重并不能保证这一条件，因此需要更严格的约束表述。
AI.method: 对一般双线性经典自旋哈密顿量建立约束形式：单子晶格情形化为关于螺旋面法向的世俗方程；双子晶格情形通过精确消除相对相位，得到定义在两个单位法向空间上的框架无关能量。通过区分保持或反转Fourier臂、保持或交换子晶格的对称操作导出对称约束，并对两个螺旋面法向进行数值优化，与纯交换扇区约束态比较；另用各向异性双子晶格基准检验。
AI.result: 在具有对称各向异性的模型中，同时优化两个螺旋面法向所得能量低于任一受约束纯交换扇区态，尽管线性哈密顿量可块对角化。另一各向异性双子晶格基准表明，即使最低LT本征模具有相等子晶格权重，强制局域圆极化仍可移动优选有序波矢。
AI.conclusion: 受约束LT表述将局域自旋长度与圆极化条件纳入优化，为经典螺旋磁序提供更可靠的能级与波矢分析；结果说明不能仅凭LT最低本征模的子晶格权重判断有序态，子晶格对称性与各向异性对波矢选择至关重要。

title: Molecular Kondo Ball Based on an Endohedral Fullerene
summary: We theoretically predict a molecular Kondo ball in TiSc$_2$N@C$_{80}$/Al(111), where a Ti-centered $S = 1/2$ local moment is encapsulated within a closed fullerene $\pi$ cage that serves as an itinerant-like electronic reservoir for Kondo screening. First-principles calculations show that intermediate molecule--substrate hybridization broadens the discrete C$_{80}$ molecular levels into itinerant-like electronic states while preserving the Ti local moment, with similar electronic conditions found for Cd(0001) and In(101).Hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM) simulations reveal a temperature-dependent Fano resonance with a Kondo temperature of about 60 K.The key electronic characteristics underlying the Kondo state remain robust against adsorption orientation, demonstrating that the closed cage geometry provides an orientation-tolerant molecular architecture for Kondo screening.

AI.tldr: 理论预测TiSc$_2$N@C$_{80}$/Al(111)中存在分子Kondo球：Ti中心$S=1/2$局域磁矩被封闭富勒烯$\pi$笼包裹，笼作为类巡游电子库实现Kondo屏蔽。
AI.motivation: 探索在保持局域磁矩的同时，利用封闭笼状分子提供类巡游电子态，从而实现可控且对吸附取向不敏感的分子Kondo体系。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理计算与分级运动方程（HEOM）模拟，分析TiSc$_2$N@C$_{80}$在Al(111)等金属衬底上的电子结构、杂化与温度依赖Fano共振。
AI.result: 中间程度的分子-衬底杂化使离散C$_{80}$分子能级展宽为类巡游电子态，同时保留Ti局域磁矩；在Cd(0001)和In(101)上出现相似电子条件。HEOM给出温度依赖Fano共振，Kondo温度约60 K，且关键电子特征对吸附取向稳健。
AI.conclusion: 封闭笼状几何提供了一种取向容忍的分子结构，可在内部局域自旋与笼状类巡游电子库之间实现Kondo屏蔽，为分子Kondo球设计提供依据。

title: Stabilizer models of achiral abelian topological orders
summary: We construct continuous-variable stabilizer codes realizing every achiral 2D abelian topological order, both bosonic and fermionic. Starting from an arbitrary signature-zero integer $K$-matrix, we show that the corresponding topological order can be obtained by condensing a lattice of dyons with trivial pairwise mutual braiding in an $\mathbb{R}^N$ gauge theory. We implement this condensation microscopically by gauging a non-on-site 1-form symmetry of the $\mathbb{R}^N$ toric code.

AI.tldr: 构造连续变量稳定子码，实现所有无手性二维阿贝尔拓扑序（玻色与费米型），核心机制是 R^N 规范理论中的 dyon 凝聚及非局域 1-form 对称性 gauging。
AI.motivation: 旨在系统覆盖任意 signature-zero 整数 K-矩阵对应的二维阿贝尔拓扑序，并给出连续变量稳定子码的统一微观构造。
AI.method: 从任意 signature-zero 整数 K-矩阵出发，在 R^N 规范理论中凝聚两两互编织平凡的 dyon 晶格；微观上通过 gauging R^N toric code 的非 on-site 1-form 对称性实现该凝聚。
AI.result: 证明该 dyon 凝聚可实现相应拓扑序，从而构造出实现所有无手性二维阿贝尔拓扑序的连续变量稳定子码，包括玻色和费米情形。
AI.conclusion: 建立了 K-矩阵、dyon 凝聚、1-form 对称性 gauging 与连续变量稳定子码之间的统一构造框架。

title: From geometric curvature to effective backgrounds: a dictionary for Dirac fermions in one, two and three spatial dimensions
summary: Dirac equation on curved backgrounds can be rewritten as a flat-space equation in which geometry appears as a tensorial Fermi velocity together with a set of background fields. We derive this correspondence from a single Clifford-algebra identity and follow it through one, two, and three spatial dimensions. Once the spin connection is written in terms of Ricci rotation coefficients, only two contractions can occur. The trace produces a term with the index structure of a vector potential in every dimensionality; it enters with an imaginary factor i and is precisely the term that keeps the operator Hermitian when the Fermi velocity depends on position. The totally antisymmetric contraction produces an object that depends on the number of indices available to the Levi-Civita symbol: a trace on a line, a pseudoscalar mass on a surface, and an axial vector potential in a volume. Neither contraction is invariant under local rotations of the frame, and we give the transformation laws. On a surface, the curl of the trace term can always be removed by a frame rotation, while its divergence is proportional to the Gaussian curvature. We apply the correspondence to a Gaussian bump, where the local density of states at the center falls below its flat value and obeys a closed form at low energy; to a wire, where a nonuniform lapse binds states inside the gap and a nonuniform velocity cannot; to stationary frames on a surface, where a circulating drag shifts the Dirac mass locally with either sign; and to twisted and rotating frames in a volume, where the axial term takes the form of a chiral chemical potential produced by the frame alone, or separates Weyl nodes in a rotating sample. We separate the geometric contribution from the lattice pseudogauge field that dominates the response of strained samples

AI.tldr: 该文从单一Clifford代数恒等式出发，系统推导弯曲背景上的Dirac方程如何等价为平空间方程，其中几何表现为张量型费米速度及由自旋联络产生的背景标量、矢量和轴矢量场，并给出1D/2D/3D分类及多类应用。
AI.motivation: 将弯曲空间Dirac方程重写为平空间形式，有助于把几何效应统一表述为位置依赖的费米速度和背景场，并区分纯几何贡献与晶格应变诱导的赝规范场。
AI.method: 利用Clifford代数恒等式建立对应关系；用Ricci旋转系数表示自旋联络，只保留迹收缩与全反对称收缩两类项；在一、二、三维中分析其指标结构、厄米性及局域标架旋转下的变换规律。
AI.result: 迹收缩在任意维度给出类矢量势项，带虚因子i并在费米速度随位置变化时保证厄米性；全反对称收缩在一维为迹、二维为赝标量质量、三维为轴矢量势。二维中迹项的旋度可由标架旋转消去，其散度正比于高斯曲率。应用于高斯凸起、导线、二维稳态标架及三维扭曲/旋转标架，分别得到低能局域态密度闭式、 lapse束缚带内态、 circulating drag导致Dirac质量局域变号、以及由标架产生的手征化学势或旋转样品中Weyl点分离。
AI.conclusion: 几何背景场可系统映射为平空间中的费米速度、矢量势、赝标量质量和轴矢量势；这些项不局域旋转不变但有明确变换律，且需与主导应变响应的晶格赝规范场区分。

title: Layer-dependent $s^{\pm}$ superconducting pairing and influence of incipient bands in La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ thin films on real LaSrAlO$_4$ substrate
summary: Motivated by recent advances in ambient-pressure superconducting La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ (LNO) thin films, we theoretically investigate these films by explicitly incorporating the realistic LaSrAlO$_4$ (LSAO) substrate. The Fermi-surface topology of the nickelate thin film closely resembles that of the high-pressure bulk phase, with similar $\alpha$ and $\beta$ sheets and a small hole-like $\gamma$ pocket originating from the surface bilayer (BL3). The bonding $d_{3z^2-r^2}$ state of the interfacial bilayer (BL1, adjacent to the LSAO substrate) lies only $\sim 5$ meV below the Fermi level, giving rise to an incipient $\gamma$ band, while for the middle bilayer (BL2) its energy is much lower ($\sim 95$ meV). Remarkably, no significant spontaneous charge transfer from the LSAO substrate to the LNO film is found. Instead, {\it symmetry-allowed charge disproportionation} occurs between the BLs, with hole doping in BL3 and electron doping in BL1 and BL2. Via the weak-coupling Random Phase Approximation, we find a strong $s^{\pm}$-wave superconducting pairing instability in BL3, while $d_{x^2-y^2}$ and $s^{\pm}$ are nearly degenerate in the other bilayers BL1 and BL2. Including the incipient $\gamma$ band via the Dynamical Cluster Approximation beyond weak coupling, robust $s^{\pm}$-wave pairing is observed in all three layers

AI.tldr: 结合真实LSAO衬底研究La3Ni2O7薄膜，发现层间对称性允许的电荷 disproportionation 与界面/表面双层能带导致稳健的 s± 波超导配对。
AI.motivation: 受常压超导 La3Ni2O7 薄膜实验进展启发，需理解真实衬底对薄膜费米面、电荷分布与超导配对的影响。
AI.method: 理论构建含 LSAO 衬底的 LNO 薄膜模型，分析费米面与双层能带；用弱耦合 RPA 研究配对不稳定性，并用超越弱耦合的 DCA 纳入 incipient γ 带。
AI.result: 费米面类似高压体相，含 α、β 片及来自表面双层 BL3 的小空穴型 γ 口袋；界面双层 BL1 的成键 d3z2-r2 态仅低于费米能约 5 meV，BL2 约 95 meV；未发现显著自发衬底到薄膜电荷转移，而层间发生对称性允许的电荷 disproportionation（BL3 空穴掺杂，BL1/BL2 电子掺杂）；RPA 给出 BL3 强 s± 配对，BL1/BL2 中 d_x2-y2 与 s± 近简并；DCA 纳入 incipient γ 带后三层均出现稳健 s± 配对。
AI.conclusion: 真实衬底诱导的层间电荷重分布与 incipient γ 带对 LNO 薄膜电子结构关键，并支持三层中稳健的 s± 波超导。

title: Orbital-weighted learning for transition metal complexes
summary: Frontier orbital energies are key to the description of molecular light-matter interaction and pose a challenge both for electronic structure calculations and for machine learning approaches, especially for transition metal complexes (TMC). These are highly relevant since the gap between the highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) and the lowest unoccupied molecular orbital (LUMO) is in the range of visible light. For TMCs, gap position and magnitude are determined by the metal center, its coordination and ligand identity. Since the systems exhibit a wide range of charge and spin states, frontier orbital energies can only be predicted with machine learning models that explicitly incorporate spin and charge. In this work, we show that a semi-empirical orbital population as a weight rather than a feature can increase efficiency for both physics-based and neural-network-based atomic representations. Because orbital populations are highly sensitive to both charge and spin, they offer a general pathway to render existing geometry-based machine learning representations useful for orbital energies. On TMC datasets, our approach reduces the required training data by up to 95 %, and improves physics-based representations to almost match the accuracy of pre-trained neural network representations at 12% of the inference compute cost. This greatly reduces the data and compute requirements to accurately model frontier orbitals in TMCs

AI.tldr: 该工作提出将半经验轨道布居作为权重而非特征，使现有基于几何的机器学习表示能有效预测过渡金属配合物的前线轨道能量，并显著降低数据与计算需求。
AI.motivation: 前线轨道能量对分子光-物质相互作用至关重要，尤其过渡金属配合物的HOMO-LUMO间隙落在可见光范围；但其预测受金属中心、配位环境和配体影响，且体系电荷与自旋态多样，机器学习模型必须显式纳入电荷和自旋信息。
AI.method: 作者将半经验轨道布居作为原子表示的权重而非输入特征，用于物理基表示和神经网络基原子表示；由于轨道布居对电荷和自旋高度敏感，该策略可赋予现有基于几何的表示预测前线轨道能量的能力。
AI.result: 在过渡金属配合物数据集上，该方法将所需训练数据减少最多95%；使物理基表示的精度接近预训练神经网络表示，同时推理计算成本仅为其12%。
AI.conclusion: 将半经验轨道布居作为权重是一种通用且高效的方式，可显著降低准确建模过渡金属配合物前线轨道所需的数据和计算资源。

title: GenerativeQC: A Generative, GPU-Accelerated Quantum Chemistry Program
summary: GenerativeQC is an open-source, GPU-accelerated quantum chemistry program that computes energies and analytic nuclear forces from Hartree-Fock (HF) and density functional theory (DFT) to closed-shell density-fitted CCSD(T) and an MP2-assisted CCSD(T)/complete-basis-set (CBS) composite. Its scientific compiler translates symbolic equations into C++ and CUDA code and uses automatic differentiation to generate the derivative and response programs that analytic forces require. A native runtime executes these programs together with hand-written iterative solvers and integral routines. Across HF and DFT benchmarks for eight methods on water clusters of up to 96 atoms, GenerativeQC is faster than GPU4PySCF in all 128 comparisons on an RTX 5090 GPU and in all but two comparisons on an H100 GPU. For correlated wave functions, compiler-generated derivative contractions and transpose Jacobian operators enable complete density-fitted CCSD(T) and CCSD(T)/CBS analytic forces on GPUs, completing a CCSD(T)/CBS energy-and-force calculation for heptane (23 atoms) in 4.5 min on a single H100 GPU (17 min on RTX 5090).

AI.tldr: GenerativeQC 是一个开源、GPU 加速的量子化学程序，可从 HF/DFT 扩展到闭壳层密度拟合 CCSD(T) 及 MP2 辅助的 CCSD(T)/CBS 复合方法，计算能量与解析核力。
AI.motivation: 在 GPU 上高效实现从 HF/DFT 到关联波函数方法（尤其是 CCSD(T)/CBS）的能量和解析核力计算，并提升相对现有 GPU 量子化学程序的性能。
AI.method: 其科学编译器将符号方程翻译为 C++ 和 CUDA 代码，并利用自动微分生成解析力所需的导数和响应程序；原生运行时执行这些程序，并结合手写迭代求解器和积分例程。
AI.result: 在最多 96 个原子的水簇上，对 8 种 HF/DFT 方法共 128 次比较中，GenerativeQC 在 RTX 5090 上全部快于 GPU4PySCF，在 H100 上仅 2 次未快于 GPU4PySCF；编译器生成的导数收缩和转置 Jacobian 算子实现了 GPU 上完整的密度拟合 CCSD(T) 和 CCSD(T)/CBS 解析力，23 原子庚烷的 CCSD(T)/CBS 能量-力计算在单张 H100 上耗时 4.5 分钟，RTX 5090 上耗时 17 分钟。
AI.conclusion: GenerativeQC 展示了通过符号编译、自动微分和 GPU 原生运行时实现高效 HF/DFT 及关联波函数解析力计算的可行性，使 CCSD(T)/CBS 级别的能量与力计算具备实际可用性。

title: xTBloom: GPU Batching for High-Throughput GFN-xTB Calculations
summary: Conformational searches and multiwindow free-energy sampling require large numbers of GFN-xTB energy and force evaluations across molecular conformations and sampling windows. Processing each system separately on a GPU makes it difficult to amortize memory management, host-device data transfer, and kernel-launch overhead. Here, we present xTBloom, a GPU batching library for GFN-xTB energy and force evaluations. xTBloom sorts evaluation queues by atomic orbital (AO) count before forming batches, accommodates size differences through a native ragged layout, maintains independent self-consistent charge (SCC) and failure states for each system, and selects execution paths according to data residency. We focus the quantitative evaluation on GFN2-xTB through cross-program comparisons on QM9 and OMol25, CPU-CUDA comparisons, finite-difference force checks, and controlled failure tests. On a near-size OMol25 workload, GPU execution achieved a 2.9-fold speedup over xTBloom's single-core CPU backend. A companion LAMMPS plugin integrates cross-window batching with periodic quantum mechanical/molecular mechanical (QM/MM) simulation. In a short synchronized test with 48 windows on one GPU, the complete coupled workflow achieved an aggregate speedup of approximately 14 over sequential execution of the same windows. These results demonstrate the throughput benefits of batched GFN-xTB evaluation for repeated electronic-structure calculations and multiwindow sampling.

AI.tldr: xTBloom 是一个面向 GFN-xTB 能量与力计算的 GPU 批处理库，通过按原子轨道数排序、ragged 批布局和独立 SCC/失败状态管理，提高重复电子结构计算与多窗口采样的吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 构象搜索和多窗口自由能采样需要大量 GFN-xTB 能量与力评估；逐系统单独在 GPU 上处理难以摊薄内存管理、主机-设备数据传输和 kernel 启动开销。
AI.method: xTBloom 在组批前按原子轨道（AO）数对评估队列排序，用原生 ragged 布局容纳不同尺寸体系，为每个体系维护独立的 SCC 与失败状态，并根据数据驻留位置选择执行路径。定量评估聚焦 GFN2-xTB，包括 QM9/OMol25 跨程序比较、CPU-CUDA 比较、有限差分力校验和受控失败测试；并提供 LAMMPS 插件，将跨窗口批处理与周期性 QM/MM 模拟集成。
AI.result: 在接近同尺寸的 OMol25 工作负载上，GPU 执行相对 xTBloom 单核 CPU 后端获得 2.9 倍加速；在单 GPU、48 个窗口的短同步测试中，完整耦合工作流相对逐窗口顺序执行取得约 14 倍总体加速。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，批处理 GFN-xTB 评估可显著提升重复电子结构计算和多窗口采样的吞吐量。

title: Toward high-throughput, low-latency structural biology using light, Part I: Protein-ligand pose determination
summary: We demonstrate for the first time that an optical spectroscopy - electron-vibration-vibration two-dimensional infrared spectroscopy (EVV 2DIR) - has sufficient structural competence to enable the reconstruction of the three-dimensional geometries of drug-protein binding at the level needed for practical drug discovery applications. Klug et al. previously demonstrated experimental detection of drug binding to a kinase using EVV 2DIR. Here we use a quantum mechanical approach to calculate and assign elements of EVV 2DIR spectra for the spectral region 1200-1800 cm$^{-1}$ / 1100-1800 cm$^{-1}$ of 92 protein-ligand complexes. This dataset includes ligand-target poses drawn from existing crystal structures and ligand-target poses created by docking and cofolding models. We find that binding-dependent spectral features are robust, interpretable, and consistent across poses in a given binding mode, and distinct for each unique hydrogen bonding geometry. We construct a spectral distance metric to distinguish poses that conform to the ligand-target hydrogen-bonding pattern of the crystal structure from those that do not. These results show that, given a set of predicted ligand-target poses containing the correct geometry, the hydrogen-bonding pattern of the valid pose may be rapidly identified by comparing simulated and experimental EVV 2DIR spectra. Finally, we discuss the practical implications for a new, high throughput structural biology for drug discovery that will be the subject of forthcoming manuscripts, noting that the base technologies to perform EVV 2DIR quickly and efficiently already exist and will enable a novel structure to be determined in only minutes for each sample. Moreover, this can be achieved without the need for crystallization, isotopic labeling, or low temperatures, non-destructively using picogram quantities of material.

AI.tldr: 该文首次证明EVV 2DIR光谱具有足够结构分辨能力，可用于重建药物-蛋白结合的三维几何，满足实际药物发现需求。
AI.motivation: 药物发现需要快速获取药物-靶标结合结构，但传统结构生物学常依赖结晶、同位素标记或低温条件，限制通量与实用性。
AI.method: 采用量子力学方法计算并指认92个蛋白-配体复合物在1200–1800 cm⁻¹/1100–1800 cm⁻¹区域的EVV 2DIR谱，样本包含晶体结构姿态及对接/共折叠预测姿态，并构建谱距离度量以区分符合晶体结构氢键模式的姿态。
AI.result: 发现结合相关谱特征稳健、可解释，在同一结合模式的姿态间一致，并对不同氢键几何具有特异性；通过比较模拟与实验EVV 2DIR谱，可快速识别包含正确几何的有效姿态。
AI.conclusion: EVV 2DIR有望支持面向药物发现的高通量结构生物学：无需结晶、同位素标记或低温，非破坏性、皮克级样品即可在数分钟内确定新结构。

title: Mesh Sensitivity of Different Boundary Treatments in High-Order Compact Gas-Kinetic Scheme for Hypersonic Heat-Flux Prediction
summary: Accurate wall-heat-flux prediction in hypersonic flow depends on both the wall treatment and the available near-wall resolution. This work compares three complete implementations of a gas-kinetic scheme (GKS) for Mach~8.03 laminar flow over an isothermal circular cylinder: a linear Green--Gauss scheme (GG), a compact ghost-cell scheme (GC), and a pointwise one-sided compact scheme (POS). In POS, the stationary isothermal-wall conditions are imposed at the two Gaussian points used by the kinetic wall-flux quadrature. A reference mesh and six meshes in the uniform reduction (UR), log-layer unpacked (LLU), and log-layer packed (LLP) families are used to assess heat-flux sensitivity. At 24 digitized experimental angles, GG has the lowest root-mean-square difference on the reference, UR, and LLP families, whereas POS is closest on the two LLU meshes; GC is not the lowest-RMS scheme on any tested mesh. Hence no treatment is uniformly superior. On the present high-aspect-ratio cylinder grids, GG is the more robust choice except under LLU node redistribution, for which POS is preferable. Uniform reduction produces the largest heat-flux response for all three implementations. The comparison concerns complete schemes and does not isolate the pointwise constraints from differences in reconstruction and geometry representation.

AI.tldr: 该文比较了高超声速圆柱绕流中三种完整GKS壁面处理的壁面热流预测精度与网格敏感性。
AI.motivation: 高超声速壁面热流预测同时受壁面处理和近壁分辨率影响，需评估不同完整GKS实现及网格族下的适用性。
AI.method: 对Mach 8.03层流等温圆柱绕流，比较线性Green-Gauss（GG）、紧致鬼胞（GC）和逐点单边紧致（POS）三种GKS实现；POS在两个高斯点施加静止等温壁条件。采用参考网格及UR、LLU、LLP三类共六个网格，并在24个数字化实验角度上评估热流误差。
AI.result: GG在参考网格、UR和LLP网格族上RMS差异最低，POS在两个LLU网格上最接近实验，GC在任何测试网格上均非最低RMS；均匀加密（UR）下三种实现的热流响应最大。
AI.conclusion: 没有一种壁面处理在所有情况下均最优；当前高长宽比圆柱网格上GG更稳健，但在LLU节点重分布下POS更优。该比较针对完整方案，未分离逐点约束与重构、几何表示差异的影响。

title: The state of nuclear data for fusion activation simulations
summary: This report compares decay-heat calculations made with four nuclear data libraries, TENDL-2025, ENDF/B-VIII.1, JEFF-4.0 and JENDL-5, against the JAEA FNS decay-heat benchmark. The main comparison uses the 2000 campaign, in which 73 foils were irradiated for five minutes in a mostly 14 MeV neutron field and their decay heat was measured for about an hour. The 1996 seven-hour campaign, with 29 foils and cooling times of up to 400 days, is compared separately and is not included in the rankings. Over the 69 elemental foils solved by all four libraries, the median deviation from the measurement (the mean absolute C/E deviation of each foil) is JENDL-5 17 percent, TENDL-2025 19 percent, JEFF-4.0 22 percent and ENDF/B-VIII.1 44 percent. No library is best everywhere: JENDL-5 on 24, JEFF-4.0 on 18, TENDL-2025 on 17 and ENDF/B-VIII.1 on 10 of the foils. For each element the report breaks the heat down by product and lists the nuclear data on which the libraries differ, and the final sections propose measurements, including enriched-isotope irradiations, that would resolve the largest differences.

AI.tldr: 该报告用四个核数据库（TENDL-2025、ENDF/B-VIII.1、JEFF-4.0、JENDL-5）对JAEA FNS衰变热基准进行计算比较；JENDL-5中位偏差最低（17%），ENDF/B-VIII.1最高（44%），无单一数据库全面最优。
AI.motivation: 评估最新核数据库对14 MeV中子场中辐照箔片衰变热的预测能力，并识别导致库间差异的核数据及需补充的测量。
AI.method: 以2000年FNS campaign为主：73个箔片在主要为14 MeV中子场辐照5分钟，测量约1小时衰变热；对四个库均能求解的69个元素箔进行排名比较。1996年7小时、29个箔片、冷却至400天的campaign单独比较且不纳入排名。报告还按产物分解各元素衰变热，并列出库间不同的核数据。
AI.result: 69个元素箔的平均绝对C/E偏差中位数：JENDL-5为17%，TENDL-2025为19%，JEFF-4.0为22%，ENDF/B-VIII.1为44%。各库最优箔数分别为JENDL-5 24个、JEFF-4.0 18个、TENDL-2025 17个、ENDF/B-VIII.1 10个。
AI.conclusion: 没有数据库在所有箔片上最优；最大差异需通过针对性测量（包括富集同位素辐照）来解决。

title: Scalable Non-Parametric Bayesian Inference of Free Energy Landscapes and Emission Functions from Observations
summary: Free-energy landscapes govern processes from protein conformational change to climate oscillations, but are typically observed only indirectly, through observables such as FRET intensity or optical-tweezer transmittance. Neither the landscape shape, nor the emission function mapping latent state to signal, is usually known, and distinct states may produce the same signal. We therefore infer landscape and emission function jointly and non-parametrically, using the exact non-linear Bayesian filtering likelihood, to fully use the information contained in observable trajectories that are often noisy, scarce and costly to acquire. A novel parallel-in-time algorithm makes this tractable: it is up to 27 times faster than sequential filtering on one GPU, scales near-ideally across GPUs, and, given enough resources, has runtime independent of trajectory length. We demonstrate the method on a single-protein optical tweezer recording, where distinct conformations produce the same signal, and beyond biology on the El Nino-Southern Oscillation and financial market volatility.

AI.tldr: 该文提出联合非参数推断自由能景观与发射函数的方法，利用精确非线性贝叶斯滤波似然充分利用含噪、稀缺、昂贵的可观测轨迹，并用新型时间并行算法实现高效计算。
AI.motivation: 自由能景观通常只能通过FRET强度、光镊透射率等间接观测量观测；景观形状和从潜在状态到信号的发射函数通常未知，且不同状态可能产生相同信号，因此需要联合推断。
AI.method: 基于精确非线性贝叶斯滤波似然，对景观和发射函数进行联合非参数推断；提出并行时间算法，使计算可行，并在单GPU上较顺序滤波最高加速27倍，跨GPU近理想扩展，资源充足时运行时间与轨迹长度无关。
AI.result: 在单蛋白光镊记录中展示方法可处理不同构象产生相同信号的情况，并应用于厄尔尼诺-南方涛动和金融市场波动率；算法在单GPU上最高27倍加速，跨GPU近理想扩展，资源充足时运行时间不随轨迹长度增长。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能联合恢复自由能景观与发射函数，充分利用噪声大、稀缺且获取成本高的轨迹数据，适用于生物物理及更广泛的复杂系统动力学分析。
